generic.Defined scope/population: All claims and exposure records for every in-force class code, CRESTA zone, construction type and customer segment.
generic.In-scope period: The last 12 rolling quarters ending at the closed-quarter data-as-at date stated in the trend workbook.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Claim count, incurred amount, exposure units, class code, CRESTA or state, construction type and segment on every row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claim counts and incurred totals in the trend workbook tie to the claims mart extract for the same period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Trend workbook saved with data-as-at date, paid or incurred basis and version number in the header.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every segment outside the frequency or severity tolerance carries a written driver comment and a monitor or act disposition.
generic.Test population: All segment rows in the published frequency and severity trend output.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any of the 12 quarters, the prior-year comparative or a required dimension is missing from the output.
generic.Exception handling path: Flagged segments without a driver comment return to the Portfolio Analyst for research before the trend pack is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Trends by class, geography, construction and segment with prior-year comparatives and a large-loss versus attritional split.
generic.Evidence location: Trend workbook and its source extract stored in the quarterly portfolio reporting folder.

steps.title: Extract claim and exposure data from the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Query the claims and exposure marts for 12 rolling quarters at class code, CRESTA or state, construction and segment grain.
Restrict the pull to the closed-quarter data-as-at date and record the paid or incurred basis used.
Compare row counts and incurred totals against the source mart control figures.
Done when the extract is loaded and its totals match the source mart.
verify: Confirm the extract covers 12 consecutive quarters with no missing quarter.
Pass when extract counts and incurred totals tie to the claims mart for the same period.

steps.title: Compute frequency and severity per segment in Microsoft Excel
sop: Calculate claim frequency per 100 exposure units for each class, geography, construction type and customer segment.
Calculate average severity per segment for the same grain and quarters.
Place prior-year comparatives side by side with the current values for each metric.
Done when frequency and severity with comparatives exist for every segment row.
verify: Recompute two sampled segments by hand against the raw extract.
Pass when the sampled recomputations match the workbook to the stated rounding.

steps.title: Split severity into large-loss and attritional components in Excel
sop: Apply the agreed large-loss threshold to separate large claims from attritional claims in each segment.
Recompute severity movement for both components so one loss cannot drive the whole trend.
Show the large-loss claim count behind each large-loss severity figure.
Done when every segment carries a large-loss and an attritional severity movement.
verify: Check that large-loss plus attritional incurred reconciles to total incurred per segment.
Pass when the two components sum to the segment total with no residual.

steps.title: Flag segments outside tolerance and write driver comments
sop: Flag each segment where frequency or severity moved more than the agreed tolerance versus prior year.
Write a driver comment for each flag naming rate, mix, risk selection or claims experience.
State in each comment whether the movement is large-loss or attritional driven.
Done when no flagged segment is left without a written driver comment.
verify: List all flagged segments and check each has a non-empty comment.
Pass when flagged segment count equals commented segment count.

steps.title: Publish the trend views to Power BI with basis and as-at stamps
sop: Publish the trend pages to Power BI showing frequency and severity by class, geography, construction and segment.
Stamp the data-as-at date and the paid or incurred basis on the report header.
Confirm the Power BI figures match the Excel workbook for the headline segments.
Done when the refreshed report carries the correct as-at date and basis.
verify: Cross-check three headline segments between Power BI and the workbook.
Pass when the three segments agree and the header stamps are present.

steps.title: Review the trend output with underwriting management
sop: Walk the flagged segments and their driver comments with the Underwriting Director or Manager.
Challenge any comment that does not explain the movement and send it back for rework.
Confirm the trend output is fit to feed the quarterly portfolio review pack.
Done when the reviewed trend output is accepted for onward use.
verify: Confirm the review date and reviewer are recorded against the trend workbook.
Pass when the accepted version is recorded with reviewer name and date.

generic.Defined scope/population: The signed-off quarterly portfolio pack and the source data extract used to build it for each line of business.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting quarter just closed, archived after leadership sign-off and before the next quarter opens.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: File name convention, data-as-at date, retention class, disposal date and treaty year index values all set.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Archived pack figures match the source extract totals it was built from.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Immutable PDF stored as vFinal with archive timestamp and file properties carrying the data-as-at date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Packs that cannot be archived to convention are logged with the reason and a remediation date.
generic.Test population: All quarterly portfolio packs archived in the current and prior quarter.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any draft or working version remains in the archive location or a retention field is unset.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing or misnamed archives return to the Portfolio Analyst for re-archiving before quarter close is declared.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Immutable pack plus source extract archived under the naming convention with retention class and disposal date set.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting management reporting archive indexed by quarter, line of business and reinsurance treaty year.

steps.title: Confirm leadership sign-off on the final pack in Microsoft Excel
sop: Check the quarterly pack carries the recorded underwriting leadership sign-off for the quarter.
Confirm no open comments or tracked changes remain in the workbook.
Record the sign-off name and date against the pack ready for archiving.
Done when the pack is confirmed final and signed off.
verify: Inspect the pack for unresolved comments and missing sign-off.
Pass when sign-off name and date are present and no open comments remain.

steps.title: Render the pack to an immutable PDF
sop: Export the signed-off pack to PDF with editing disabled.
Check every page rendered including Power BI visuals and appendices.
Write the data-as-at date into the PDF file properties.
Done when a complete non-editable PDF exists.
verify: Open the PDF and attempt an edit and page-count check.
Pass when the PDF is non-editable and page count matches the source pack.

steps.title: Capture the source data extract from the data warehouse
sop: Save the warehouse extract that produced the pack figures alongside the PDF.
Record the extract query, run timestamp and warehouse table versions used.
Reconcile the extract headline totals to the pack summary page.
Done when the extract is stored next to the pack and reconciles to it.
verify: Compare pack headline premium and loss to the extract totals.
Pass when the pack and extract totals agree.

steps.title: Apply the naming convention and retention settings
sop: Name the files to the convention LOB_PortfolioReview_QTR_YYYY_vFinal.
Apply the underwriting management reporting retention class to both files.
Set the disposal date derived from the retention class on the record.
Done when name, retention class and disposal date are set on both files.
verify: Read back the file name, retention class and disposal date from the archive record.
Pass when all three fields are populated and match the convention.

steps.title: Index the archive for quarter, line of business and treaty year
sop: Add index values for reporting quarter, line of business and reinsurance treaty year to the archive record.
Search the archive by each index value to confirm the pack is returned.
Remove any draft or working copies from the archive location.
Done when the pack is retrievable by all three index values and no drafts remain.
verify: Run one search per index value and list files in the archive folder.
Pass when each search returns the pack and no draft version is present.

steps.title: Confirm prior-quarter retrievability and close the archive step
sop: Retrieve the prior quarter pack from the archive as a continuity check.
Confirm the current quarter entry is complete with pack, extract and retention fields.
Record the archive completion date on the portfolio review record.
Done when both quarters are retrievable and the completion date is recorded.
verify: Open the prior quarter pack and the current quarter pack from the archive.
Pass when both open successfully and the completion date is recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every line of business with an approved plan, benchmarked on written premium, loss ratio and combined ratio.
generic.In-scope period: The closed reporting period with matching plan, prior-year and market index periods.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Actual, plan, prior-year and market index values plus index source and vintage present for each line.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Actual premium and loss totals in the benchmark view tie to the closed-period warehouse extract.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Benchmark output saved with the plan version of record and the index vintage stamped on it.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Lines outside the variance tolerance carry commentary naming rate, mix or loss experience as the driver.
generic.Test population: All lines of business shown in the published benchmark view.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the plan referenced is not the plan of record or a line lacks a market or peer benchmark.
generic.Exception handling path: Lines missing commentary return to the Portfolio Analyst before the benchmark view is published.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Actual versus plan versus prior year versus market index by line with variance in points and dollars.
generic.Evidence location: Benchmark workbook and Power BI page in the quarterly portfolio reporting folder.

steps.title: Load actuals from the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Extract actual written premium, loss ratio and combined ratio by line of business for the closed period.
Confirm the extract uses the same earned or written basis as the plan.
Record the extract timestamp and warehouse source objects.
Done when actuals for every line are loaded on the plan basis.
verify: Compare extracted premium totals to the closed-period ledger figure.
Pass when extracted totals agree with the ledger for the period.

steps.title: Confirm the plan version of record and load plan and prior year
sop: Obtain the approved plan of record and note its version and approval date.
Load plan and prior-year premium, loss ratio and combined ratio by line.
Confirm every line in the actuals has a matching plan and prior-year row.
Done when plan and prior year are loaded from the confirmed plan version.
verify: Check the loaded plan version against the approved plan of record.
Pass when the versions match and no line lacks a plan row.

steps.title: Overlay market loss index or peer benchmark
sop: Load the relevant market loss index or peer benchmark for the same period from the actuarial modeling platform.
Record the index source, vintage and any restatement applied.
Align the index periods to the reporting period before overlaying.
Done when each line carries a period-aligned market benchmark with source and vintage.
verify: Check index source and vintage are recorded for every line.
Pass when no line shows a benchmark without a source and vintage.

steps.title: Calculate and rank variance to plan
sop: Calculate variance to plan in percentage points and in dollars for each line.
Rank segments by absolute dollar variance so the largest movers sit at the top.
Highlight lines outside the agreed variance tolerance.
Done when ranked variance in points and dollars exists for every line.
verify: Recompute variance for the top two ranked lines from actual and plan values.
Pass when the recomputed variances match the published figures.

steps.title: Write commentary for lines outside tolerance
sop: Write commentary for every line more than the agreed tolerance off plan.
Name rate, mix or loss experience as the driver in each comment.
Reference the supporting trend or segment analysis behind the driver claim.
Done when every out-of-tolerance line carries driver commentary.
verify: Count out-of-tolerance lines and lines carrying commentary.
Pass when the two counts are equal.

steps.title: Review and release the benchmark view in Power BI
sop: Review the benchmark page with the Underwriting Director or Manager before release.
Confirm the plan version, index vintage and as-at date are visible on the page.
Approve the page for distribution to underwriting leadership.
Done when the reviewed benchmark page is released.
verify: Check the released page carries plan version, index vintage and reviewer name.
Pass when all three are present on the released page.

generic.Defined scope/population: The whole portfolio plus every segment and every underwriter with in-force or earned business in the period.
generic.In-scope period: The closed accounting period whose general ledger figures are available for reconciliation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Earned and written premium, incurred loss, ALAE, ULAE, acquisition and operating cost present at each level.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Total earned premium and incurred loss in the calculation tie to the general ledger close for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Ratio output saved with basis, ALAE treatment, period and calculation run timestamp stated on it.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Segments below the credibility threshold are suppressed or footnoted rather than published as volatile ratios.
generic.Test population: All portfolio, segment and underwriter ratio rows produced for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the ledger reconciliation is missing or the earned or written basis is not stated on the output.
generic.Exception handling path: Unexplained ledger differences are logged and referred to finance before the ratios are published.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Gross and net loss, expense and combined ratios at portfolio, segment and underwriter level on a stated basis.
generic.Evidence location: Ratio calculation output and reconciliation working in the period portfolio reporting folder.

steps.title: Assemble premium and loss inputs from the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Extract earned and written premium and gross and net incurred losses at portfolio, segment and underwriter grain.
Confirm the same period and the same cohort definition apply to premium and loss.
Record the extract timestamp and source objects used.
Done when premium and loss inputs are loaded at all three levels.
verify: Check every underwriter with in-force business appears in the extract.
Pass when no active underwriter is missing from the extract.

steps.title: Compute gross and net loss ratios in the actuarial modeling platform
sop: Compute gross and net loss ratios on both earned and written bases at each level.
Add ALAE and ULAE per the agreed convention.
State on the output whether the ratios are ALAE inclusive.
Done when loss ratios exist on both bases with the ALAE basis stated.
verify: Recalculate one segment loss ratio from raw premium and loss.
Pass when the recalculated ratio matches the output.

steps.title: Compute expense and combined ratios
sop: Compute the expense ratio from acquisition and operating costs allocated to each level.
Derive the combined ratio from the loss and expense ratios.
Confirm the cost allocation basis is the approved one for the period.
Done when expense and combined ratios exist at all three levels.
verify: Check combined ratio equals loss ratio plus expense ratio for sampled rows.
Pass when the sampled rows reconcile exactly.

steps.title: Reconcile earned premium and incurred loss to the ledger close
sop: Compare total earned premium and total incurred loss in the calculation to the general ledger close figures.
Record every difference with its amount and identified cause.
Refer differences that cannot be explained to finance for resolution.
Done when the reconciliation is recorded with each difference explained or referred.
verify: Inspect the reconciliation working for unexplained residuals.
Pass when no unexplained residual above tolerance remains open.

steps.title: Suppress or footnote low-credibility segments
sop: Identify segments with fewer exposures than the minimum credibility threshold.
Suppress or footnote those segments rather than publishing a volatile ratio.
List the suppressed segments and the exposure count behind each.
Done when no sub-threshold segment is published without suppression or footnote.
verify: Compare the exposure count of each published segment to the threshold.
Pass when every published sub-threshold segment carries a footnote.

steps.title: Publish the ratio pages to Power BI and obtain review
sop: Publish portfolio, segment and underwriter ratio pages to Power BI with the basis stated.
Review underwriter-level ratios for reasonableness before release.
Approve the pages for distribution and record the review date.
Done when the reviewed ratio pages are released with the basis visible.
verify: Check the released pages show basis, period and reviewer name.
Pass when all three appear on the released pages.

generic.Defined scope/population: The top emerging portfolio risks and trends identified from the current period portfolio analysis.
generic.In-scope period: The current monthly underwriting meeting cycle, briefed ahead of the meeting date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Segment, observed movement, recommended action, tag, owner and target date present for each brief item.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Every item in the brief traces to a flagged segment in the portfolio trend and performance analysis.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dated one-page brief retained with the version issued to the CUO and product management.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items tagged act now or escalate carry a named owner, target date and recorded CUO direction.
generic.Test population: All items on the issued emerging-risk brief for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any act-now item has no named owner or target date, or the brief was issued after the meeting.
generic.Exception handling path: CUO direction that changes an item is logged against the portfolio review record and reissued in the next brief.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Dated one-page brief with each item tagged monitor, act now or escalate and an owner named.
generic.Evidence location: Portfolio review record holding the brief and the logged CUO direction.

steps.title: Shortlist emerging risks from the portfolio analysis in Power BI
sop: Review the flagged segments from the trend, benchmark and concentration analysis for the period.
Shortlist the items material enough to put in front of the Chief Underwriting Officer.
Record the segment and the observed movement for each shortlisted item.
Done when the shortlist exists with movement recorded per item.
verify: Trace each shortlisted item back to its source analysis page.
Pass when every item traces to a flagged segment in the analysis.

steps.title: Draft the one-page brief in Microsoft Excel
sop: Draft the brief with segment, observed movement and recommended action on a single page.
Keep each item to a form the CUO can act on without opening the underlying analysis.
State the premium and exposure affected for each item.
Done when the one-page draft covers every shortlisted item.
verify: Check the brief fits one page and each item carries a recommended action.
Pass when no item lacks a recommended action.

steps.title: Tag items and assign owners and target dates
sop: Tag each item as monitor, act now or escalate.
Name the owner and target date for every act-now item.
Confirm escalate items name the forum they escalate to.
Done when every item is tagged and act-now items carry owner and date.
verify: Filter to act-now items and check owner and target date fields.
Pass when no act-now item is missing an owner or a target date.

steps.title: Issue the brief to the CUO and product management
sop: Send the brief to the Chief Underwriting Officer and product management ahead of the monthly underwriting meeting.
Confirm the distribution list is current before sending.
Record the send date and the recipients.
Done when the brief is sent before the meeting with recipients recorded.
verify: Compare the send date to the meeting date.
Pass when the send date precedes the meeting date.

steps.title: Take CUO direction at the underwriting meeting
sop: Review each brief item at the monthly underwriting meeting.
Give direction on act-now and escalate items including any change of tag or owner.
Confirm which items proceed to the appetite or guideline review agenda.
Done when direction is given on every act-now and escalate item.
verify: Check each act-now and escalate item has recorded direction.
Pass when no such item is left without CUO direction.

steps.title: Log the communication and direction on the portfolio review record
sop: Log the issued brief, recipients and send date against the portfolio review record.
Record the CUO direction and any owner or date changes per item.
Carry open items forward to the next period brief.
Done when brief, recipients and direction are logged on the record.
verify: Retrieve the portfolio review record and check the logged entries.
Pass when brief, recipients, date and direction are all present.

generic.Defined scope/population: All in-force and written policies by line of business and segment with their matching paid and incurred loss records.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting period being compiled, extracted at a single stated data-as-at timestamp.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Written, earned and in-force premium, policy count, paid, outstanding and incurred loss, segment, class and geography codes.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Total written premium in the extract reconciles to the bordereau or ledger control total.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Extract stamped with data-as-at timestamp and the policy and claims source system versions.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Records with null or unmapped segment, class or geography codes are routed to the data-quality log with an owner.
generic.Test population: All premium and loss records in the published extract for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any published record has a null or unmapped segment, class or geography code.
generic.Exception handling path: Unmapped records are held back from publication and returned to the data-quality log until coded.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Premium and loss extract by segment and line of business with data-as-at timestamp and control-total reconciliation.
generic.Evidence location: Warehouse extract table and the reconciliation working in the period portfolio reporting folder.

steps.title: Extract premium and policy counts from the policy administration system
sop: Pull written, earned and in-force premium and policy counts by line of business and segment.
Apply the reporting period and record the data-as-at timestamp.
Note the policy administration system version used for the pull.
Done when the premium and count extract is loaded for the period.
verify: Check the extract covers every active line of business.
Pass when no active line of business is missing from the extract.

steps.title: Join claims data from the claims data mart
sop: Join paid, outstanding and incurred losses for the same cohort and period from the claims data mart.
Match on policy and cohort keys rather than free-text descriptions.
List policies with no matching claims record and confirm they are genuinely claim free.
Done when losses are joined to the premium extract on matched keys.
verify: Count unmatched claim records left outside the joined set.
Pass when every claim record in the period matches a policy or is listed as an exception.

steps.title: Reconcile written premium to the control total
sop: Compare total written premium in the extract to the bordereau or ledger control total.
Record the variance amount and its cause.
Escalate variances above tolerance to the Portfolio UW Manager.
Done when the reconciliation and any variance cause are recorded.
verify: Inspect the recorded variance against the agreed tolerance.
Pass when the variance is within tolerance or has a recorded cause.

steps.title: Run code validation on segment, class and geography
sop: Check every record for null or unmapped segment, class and geography codes.
Route unmapped records to the data-quality log with the failing field named.
Hold unmapped records out of the published extract.
Done when the published extract contains no unmapped code values.
verify: Query the published extract for null or unmapped code values.
Pass when the query returns zero rows.

steps.title: Stamp and publish the extract in the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Stamp the extract with the data-as-at timestamp and source system versions.
Publish the extract to the warehouse location used by the portfolio reporting layer.
Confirm the Power BI datasets pick up the new extract on refresh.
Done when the stamped extract is published and consumed by reporting.
verify: Open the published extract header and the Power BI refresh log.
Pass when the stamps are present and the refresh consumed the new extract.

steps.title: Review the compiled metrics before downstream use
sop: Review headline premium, count and loss figures for reasonableness against the prior period.
Challenge any movement that cannot be explained by known portfolio activity.
Accept the extract for use in ratio, trend and pack production.
Done when the extract is accepted for downstream use.
verify: Confirm the acceptance is recorded with reviewer name and date.
Pass when reviewer name and date are recorded against the extract.

generic.Defined scope/population: All standard sections of the quarterly portfolio review pack across every line of business in scope for the review.
generic.In-scope period: The closed quarter, with the pack circulated at least five working days before the review meeting.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Overview, premium and mix movement, loss ratio walk, top segments, CAT summary and action log all completed.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Headline loss ratio and premium on the summary page agree to the detail pages and the ledger close.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Pack version and the dashboard refresh timestamp for the closed-quarter dataset recorded on the pack.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Open items from the prior quarter action log are carried forward with a current status against each.
generic.Test population: All sections and action-log items in the compiled quarterly pack.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a standard section is missing or the dashboard refresh predates the closed-quarter dataset.
generic.Exception handling path: Sections that fail the summary-to-detail cross-check are returned to the Portfolio Analyst before circulation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete pack with all standard sections and a carried-forward action log showing current status.
generic.Evidence location: Quarterly portfolio review folder holding the pack and the refreshed Power BI dashboard.

steps.title: Assemble the standard pack sections in Microsoft Excel
sop: Build the portfolio overview, premium and mix movement, loss ratio walk, top segments and CAT exposure summary sections.
Use the closed-quarter warehouse extract as the single source for every section.
Keep the standard section order and titles so quarter-on-quarter comparison holds.
Done when every standard section is present and populated.
verify: Check the pack contents against the standard section list.
Pass when no standard section is missing.

steps.title: Refresh the leadership dashboard in Power BI
sop: Refresh the leadership dashboard against the closed-quarter dataset.
Confirm the refresh completed without dataset errors.
Display the refresh timestamp on the report page.
Done when the dashboard is refreshed and the timestamp is shown.
verify: Compare the refresh timestamp to the closed-quarter dataset load time.
Pass when the refresh timestamp is later than the dataset load.

steps.title: Carry forward the prior quarter action log
sop: Copy the prior quarter action log into the pack with each item intact.
Update the current status, owner and due date on every open item.
Mark closed items with the closure date and evidence reference.
Done when every prior item carries a current status.
verify: Compare open item count in the prior pack to items carried forward.
Pass when no prior open item is missing from the current log.

steps.title: Cross-check summary figures against detail and ledger
sop: Compare headline loss ratio and premium on the summary page to the detailed pages.
Compare the same figures to the general ledger close for the quarter.
Correct or explain every difference before circulation.
Done when summary, detail and ledger figures agree or differences are explained.
verify: Re-run the summary to detail comparison after corrections.
Pass when the comparison shows no unexplained difference.

steps.title: Circulate the draft pack to underwriting leadership
sop: Send the draft pack to underwriting leadership at least five working days before the review meeting.
State the comment deadline in the circulation note.
Record the circulation date and recipient list.
Done when the draft is circulated within the lead time with recipients recorded.
verify: Compare circulation date to the review meeting date.
Pass when at least five working days separate the two dates.

steps.title: Incorporate review comments and finalise the pack
sop: Collect comments from the Underwriting Director or Manager and underwriting leadership.
Direct the Portfolio Analyst on which comments change the pack and which are noted.
Approve the final version for the review meeting.
Done when the final pack is approved for the meeting.
verify: Check the final pack version and approval date are recorded.
Pass when version and approval date are recorded on the pack.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every underwriting team with in-force business, each receiving its own segment scorecard.
generic.In-scope period: The closed quarter whose portfolio results have been reviewed and signed off.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Loss ratio, hit ratio and retention against target plus the actions note present on every team scorecard.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Team scorecard totals sum back to the portfolio results issued in the quarterly pack.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Send date, scorecard version and recipient list recorded on the portfolio review record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Distribution failures or missing teams are logged and resent with the reason recorded.
generic.Test population: All team scorecards distributed for the quarter.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any underwriter-level result is visible to a team outside the owning manager.
generic.Exception handling path: Access errors are corrected by the Portfolio Analyst and the affected scorecard is reissued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Team scorecards showing loss ratio, hit ratio and retention against target with a dated recipient list.
generic.Evidence location: Power BI workspace holding the scorecards and the portfolio review record holding the send log.

steps.title: Build the team segment scorecards in Power BI
sop: Build a scorecard per underwriting team showing loss ratio, hit ratio and retention against target.
Source every figure from the signed-off quarterly results.
Check that team totals sum back to the portfolio result.
Done when a scorecard exists for every underwriting team.
verify: Sum team scorecard figures and compare to the portfolio result.
Pass when the team sum equals the portfolio result.

steps.title: Apply row-level access so managers see only their team
sop: Apply row-level security so each manager sees only their own team rows.
Test access using a sample account from two different teams.
Correct any rule that leaks underwriter-level rows across teams.
Done when the access test shows no cross-team visibility.
verify: View the scorecard as a sample account from each of two teams.
Pass when neither test account sees another team's underwriter rows.

steps.title: Write the what this means for you note in Microsoft Excel
sop: Write a short note per team naming the two or three actions expected this quarter.
Tie each action to the team's own scorecard movement.
Keep the note to actions the team can influence.
Done when every team scorecard carries an actions note.
verify: Check each scorecard for an attached actions note.
Pass when no scorecard is issued without an actions note.

steps.title: Confirm the distribution list against the current org structure
sop: Check the recipient list against the current underwriting organisation structure.
Add new managers and remove leavers and moved staff.
Confirm each team has exactly one owning manager on the list.
Done when the distribution list matches the current structure.
verify: Compare the list against the current org structure record.
Pass when the list and the structure agree with no orphan team.

steps.title: Distribute the scorecards to underwriting teams
sop: Publish each team scorecard to its owning manager with the actions note attached.
Confirm delivery to every recipient on the confirmed list.
Resend any failed delivery and record the reason.
Done when every team on the list has received its scorecard.
verify: Check delivery status for each recipient.
Pass when no recipient on the list is left undelivered.

steps.title: Record the send date and recipient list on the review record
sop: Record the send date, scorecard version and full recipient list on the portfolio review record.
Attach the access-test evidence to the same record.
File any resend and its reason alongside.
Done when send date, version and recipients are recorded.
verify: Retrieve the portfolio review record for the quarter.
Pass when send date, version and recipient list are all present.

generic.Defined scope/population: All portfolio segments with credible volume, ranked on developed ultimate loss ratio.
generic.In-scope period: The accident or underwriting periods covered by the current loss development factor set.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Ultimate loss ratio, development factor set, exposure volume, premium at risk, owner and proposed action per segment.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Segment premium at risk sums back to total portfolio premium for the segments analysed.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Analysis saved with the actuarial development factor version and the data-as-at date used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Segments below the credibility volume threshold appear only with a footnote explaining their inclusion.
generic.Test population: All segments on the underperformance shortlist for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if ranking uses reported-only loss ratios rather than developed ultimates.
generic.Exception handling path: Segments failing the credibility test are removed or footnoted before the shortlist is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Ranked shortlist on developed ultimate loss ratios with premium at risk and an owner per segment.
generic.Evidence location: Underperformance analysis workbook and Power BI page in the quarterly portfolio folder.

steps.title: Obtain development factors from the actuarial modeling platform
sop: Obtain the current loss development factor set for each segment and period.
Record the factor set version and the actuarial approval date.
Confirm the factors cover every segment in scope.
Done when an approved factor set is available for all in-scope segments.
verify: Check each in-scope segment has a matching development factor.
Pass when no segment lacks a factor from the approved set.

steps.title: Compute ultimate loss ratios and rank segments
sop: Apply the development factors to reported losses to derive ultimate loss ratios by segment.
Rank segments by ultimate loss ratio rather than reported-only figures.
Show the reported and ultimate figures side by side for transparency.
Done when a ranked ultimate loss ratio table exists for all segments.
verify: Recompute one segment ultimate from reported loss and its factor.
Pass when the recomputed ultimate matches the table.

steps.title: Apply the underperformance and credibility tests
sop: Apply the agreed test of loss ratio above target for two or more consecutive periods.
Apply the credibility volume threshold and footnote any segment below it.
Exclude segments failing credibility from the ranked shortlist unless footnoted.
Done when the tests are applied and sub-threshold segments are footnoted.
verify: Check every shortlisted segment against the credibility threshold.
Pass when no sub-threshold segment appears without a footnote.

steps.title: Separate rate adequacy from selection and claims drivers
sop: Split failing segments into rate adequacy failures and risk selection or claims experience failures.
Support each classification with the rate change, mix and claims evidence.
Note segments where more than one driver applies.
Done when every shortlisted segment carries a driver classification.
verify: Check each shortlisted segment for a driver classification.
Pass when no shortlisted segment is unclassified.

steps.title: Quantify premium at risk per shortlisted segment
sop: Calculate the in-force premium exposed in each shortlisted segment.
Show the renewal timing profile so remediation can be sequenced.
Sum premium at risk across the shortlist for the leadership summary.
Done when premium at risk is quantified for every shortlisted segment.
verify: Compare the shortlist premium sum to the portfolio premium base.
Pass when the shortlist premium reconciles to the portfolio base.

steps.title: Assign owner and proposed action and issue the shortlist
sop: Assign an owner and a proposed action of re-rate, restrict, exit or refer to each shortlisted segment.
Agree the target date for each action with the owning manager.
Issue the shortlist to underwriting management for execution.
Done when every shortlisted segment has an owner and a proposed action.
verify: Filter the shortlist for blank owner or action fields.
Pass when no shortlisted segment has a blank owner or action.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every peril zone whose modelled accumulation sits inside the warning band of an internal or reinsurance threshold.
generic.In-scope period: From the guideline effective date until the accumulation position returns below the warning band.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Zone, threshold breached, tightened rule, approver, approval date and effective date recorded per change.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Zones with an active tightened rule match the zones flagged in the latest accumulation run.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Guideline change record retained with approver, dates and the accumulation run identifier that triggered it.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: In-flight quotes handled outside the new rule are logged against the stated transition treatment.
generic.Test population: All peril zones with a tightened CAT rule applied in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a tightened zone has no active referral trigger in the underwriting workstation.
generic.Exception handling path: Submissions in affected zones route to exposure management for referral rather than automatic decline.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Tightened CAT rule per affected zone with approver, approval date and effective date recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Guideline change record in the warehouse and the rule configuration in the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Identify zones inside the warning band in Power BI
sop: Review the latest accumulation run against internal and reinsurance thresholds by peril zone.
List every zone within the agreed warning band or already over threshold.
Record the accumulation run identifier behind the list.
Done when the affected zone list is produced with the run identifier.
verify: Compare the zone list to the utilisation view for the same run.
Pass when the list matches the zones flagged in that run.

steps.title: Draft the tightened rule per affected zone
sop: Draft the tightened rule for each zone covering maximum TIV per location, deductible, referral limit or closure to new business.
State the expected exposure relief from each proposed rule.
Set out the transition treatment for in-flight quotes.
Done when a drafted rule and transition treatment exist for every affected zone.
verify: Check each affected zone has a drafted rule and transition treatment.
Pass when no affected zone is left without both.

steps.title: Obtain CUO approval for the guideline change
sop: Review the drafted rules against exposure relief, premium impact and appetite.
Record the approve, amend or reject decision per zone with rationale.
Set the effective date for the approved changes.
Done when every zone rule carries a recorded decision and effective date.
verify: Check the change record for approver name, decision and effective date.
Pass when all three are recorded for every approved zone.

steps.title: Configure the referral trigger in the underwriting workstation
sop: Configure the referral trigger so submissions in the affected zones route to exposure management.
Set the trigger to activate on the approved effective date.
Deactivate any superseded zone rule at the same time.
Done when the trigger is configured and dated for each affected zone.
verify: Submit a test risk in an affected zone in the workstation.
Pass when the test risk is referred to exposure management.

steps.title: Notify underwriting teams and distribution of the change
sop: Issue the change note stating the zones affected, the new rule and the effective date.
Explain the transition treatment for in-flight quotes and brokered submissions.
Confirm the note reached underwriters writing in the affected zones.
Done when the note is issued before the effective date with recipients recorded.
verify: Compare the issue date to the effective date.
Pass when the note issued before the effective date.

steps.title: Confirm in-flight quotes are handled under the transition rule
sop: List quotes in the affected zones that were live at the effective date.
Confirm each was handled under the stated transition treatment.
Log any exception with the approver who allowed it.
Done when every in-flight quote is confirmed or logged as an exception.
verify: Check the in-flight quote list against the transition treatment applied.
Pass when no in-flight quote was bound outside the transition rule without a logged approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: All in-force locations across every modelled peril, rolled up to CRESTA or peril-zone level.
generic.In-scope period: The in-force position at the stated as-at date used for the accumulation cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Location identifier, peril zone, gross TIV, net of facultative TIV and net of treaty TIV present on every row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Summed zonal TIV reconciles to total in-force TIV with no unallocated remainder.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Zonal TIV table published with the in-force as-at date and the zone scheme version used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Locations that cannot be allocated to a zone are logged with the reason and a resolution owner.
generic.Test population: All zonal TIV rows and the underlying in-force location set.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any in-force location value is left unallocated to a peril zone.
generic.Exception handling path: Unallocated locations return to the Portfolio Analyst for zone assignment before publication.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Zonal TIV table showing gross, net of facultative and net of treaty by peril zone with as-at date and scheme version.
generic.Evidence location: Warehouse zonal TIV table and the Power BI accumulation page for the cycle.

steps.title: Extract the in-force location file from the policy administration system
sop: Extract all in-force locations with sums insured, coverage split and policy references at the as-at date.
Record the as-at date and the policy system version used.
Compare the location count to the prior cycle and explain material movement.
Done when the in-force location file is extracted at a stated as-at date.
verify: Compare extracted total TIV to the in-force TIV control figure.
Pass when extracted total TIV equals the control figure.

steps.title: De-duplicate locations shared across policies
sop: Identify locations appearing on more than one policy using the location identifier.
Include each shared location once only in the aggregation base.
Record the de-duplication count and the value removed.
Done when the aggregation base holds each location once.
verify: Count distinct location identifiers against total rows in the base.
Pass when distinct identifiers equal the row count.

steps.title: Assign each location to a CRESTA or peril zone
sop: Assign every location to a zone for each modelled peril using the current zone scheme.
Record the zone scheme version applied.
Route unassignable locations to the exception log with the reason.
Done when every location carries a zone for each modelled peril.
verify: Query the base for locations with a missing zone assignment.
Pass when the query returns zero rows outside the exception log.

steps.title: Aggregate gross, net of facultative and net of treaty TIV
sop: Roll up TIV to zone level separately on gross, net of facultative and net of treaty bases.
Apply the current facultative cessions and treaty structure to derive the net positions.
Show the retained position explicitly for each zone.
Done when all three bases are aggregated for every zone.
verify: Check net of treaty TIV is not greater than gross TIV in any zone.
Pass when every zone shows net at or below gross on both net bases.

steps.title: Reconcile zonal totals back to in-force TIV
sop: Sum zonal TIV across all zones and compare to total in-force TIV.
Investigate and resolve any unallocated remainder.
Record the reconciliation and the residual amount if any.
Done when the reconciliation is recorded with no unexplained remainder.
verify: Inspect the reconciliation for an unallocated remainder.
Pass when the remainder is zero or fully explained.

steps.title: Publish the zonal TIV table with as-at date and scheme version
sop: Publish the zonal TIV table to the warehouse and the Power BI accumulation page.
Stamp the in-force as-at date and zone scheme version on the published output.
Notify the CAT Modeler that the zonal base is ready for modelling.
Done when the stamped table is published and the CAT Modeler is notified.
verify: Open the published table header and check the stamps.
Pass when as-at date and zone scheme version are both present.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every peril zone whose capacity allocation is proposed to change in the current allocation cycle.
generic.In-scope period: The allocation period running from the approved effective date to the next scheduled allocation review.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Zone, proposed capacity, modelled PML, decision, rationale, approver and effective date recorded per zone.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Total allocated capacity across zones does not exceed the approved aggregate CAT limit.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed allocation retained with approver name, signature date and effective date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Approve-with-conditions zones carry the conditions written out and an owner for each condition.
generic.Test population: All changed zonal allocations in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the summed allocation exceeds the approved aggregate CAT limit.
generic.Exception handling path: Rejected or conditional zones return to exposure management for rework before loading.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Signed zonal capacity allocation with a per-zone decision, rationale, approver and effective date.
generic.Evidence location: Signed allocation workbook in the CAT governance folder with the Power BI supporting view.

steps.title: Review proposed capacity against modelled PML in Power BI
sop: Review the proposed capacity for each peril zone against modelled PML at the standard return periods.
Check the proposal against the reinsurance program structure and board risk appetite.
Question any zone where proposed capacity is not supported by the modelled position.
Done when every proposed zone has been reviewed against PML and appetite.
verify: Check each proposed zone has an attached PML figure and appetite reference.
Pass when no proposed zone lacks either.

steps.title: Confirm the aggregate does not exceed the approved CAT limit
sop: Sum the proposed capacity across all zones in Microsoft Excel.
Compare the total to the approved aggregate CAT limit.
Rework the proposal if the total exceeds the aggregate limit.
Done when the summed allocation sits within the aggregate CAT limit.
verify: Recompute the sum of proposed zonal capacity.
Pass when the recomputed sum is at or below the aggregate limit.

steps.title: Record the decision and rationale per changed zone
sop: Record approve, approve with conditions or reject against each changed zone.
Write the rationale in enough detail for a reviewer to follow without discussion.
Write out any conditions in full with an owner for each.
Done when every changed zone carries a decision and rationale.
verify: Filter changed zones for blank decision or rationale.
Pass when no changed zone has a blank decision or rationale.

steps.title: Sign off the allocation and set the effective date
sop: Sign the allocation with name, role and date.
Set the effective date for the new zonal limits.
Confirm the version signed is the reworked final version.
Done when the allocation is signed and dated with an effective date set.
verify: Open the signed allocation and check name, role, date and effective date.
Pass when all four fields are present.

steps.title: Instruct exposure management to load the approved limits
sop: Issue the instruction to load the approved limits before the next accumulation run.
Attach the signed allocation to the instruction.
Confirm the loading owner and the deadline.
Done when the instruction is issued with the signed allocation attached.
verify: Check the instruction carries the signed allocation and a deadline.
Pass when both are present on the issued instruction.

steps.title: Confirm the approved limits are in force for the next run
sop: Load the approved zonal limits into the monitoring and reporting layer.
Confirm the prior allocation is superseded on the effective date.
Run one zone check to confirm utilisation is measured against the new limit.
Done when the new limits drive the next accumulation monitoring run.
verify: Compare the limit shown in the utilisation view to the signed allocation.
Pass when the utilisation view uses the newly approved limits.

generic.Defined scope/population: All in-force policies and locations falling inside the published event footprint for the named event.
generic.In-scope period: From event confirmation or landfall until the final footprint version is assessed and closed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Exposed policy count, exposed TIV, deductible band, coverage, policy status and footprint vintage present.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exposed TIV by status and coverage sums back to total exposed TIV for the event.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each assessment version retained with the footprint vintage and the issue timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Policies excluded from the exposed set are logged with the reason such as expired cover or out-of-scope peril.
generic.Test population: All assessment versions issued for the event.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the initial assessment misses the agreed post-event timeframe.
generic.Exception handling path: Footprint updates trigger a reissued assessment rather than an edit of the prior version.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Exposed count, exposed TIV, gross loss range and expected reinsurance attachment labelled with footprint vintage.
generic.Evidence location: Event response folder holding each assessment version and its underlying exposed policy extract.

steps.title: Obtain the event footprint from the catastrophe data provider
sop: Download the published wind swath, shake map or fire perimeter for the named event.
Record the footprint vendor, vintage and publication timestamp.
Confirm the footprint projection matches the exposure coordinate system.
Done when the footprint is loaded with its vintage recorded.
verify: Check the recorded footprint vintage against the provider publication.
Pass when the loaded footprint vintage matches the published version.

steps.title: Overlay the footprint on the in-force location file
sop: Overlay the footprint on the geocoded in-force location file in the warehouse.
Identify every policy and location inside the footprint boundary.
Exclude locations whose cover was not in force at the event date and log them.
Done when the exposed policy and location set is produced.
verify: Spot-check three exposed locations against the footprint boundary.
Pass when all three sampled locations fall inside the footprint.

steps.title: Produce exposed count, exposed TIV and gross loss range
sop: Calculate exposed policy count and exposed TIV from the overlay result.
Estimate a gross loss range using the agreed damage assumptions for the peril.
State the assumptions behind the low and high ends of the range.
Done when count, TIV and a gross loss range are produced.
verify: Check exposed TIV sums to the exposed location values.
Pass when exposed TIV reconciles to the exposed location set.

steps.title: Split exposure by status, deductible band and coverage
sop: Split exposed exposure by policy status, deductible band and coverage type.
Derive the net retained estimate from the split.
Show which splits carry the largest share of estimated loss.
Done when the split and net retained estimate are produced.
verify: Sum the split categories and compare to total exposed TIV.
Pass when the split sums to total exposed TIV.

steps.title: Compare modelled loss to reinsurance attachment points
sop: Compare the modelled event loss to the attachment point of each reinsurance layer.
State which layers are expected to be triggered at the low, central and high estimate.
Note reinstatement implications for triggered layers.
Done when expected layer attachment is stated for each estimate level.
verify: Check the attachment points used against the current treaty structure.
Pass when the attachment points match the in-force treaty terms.

steps.title: Issue and reissue the assessment within the agreed timeframe
sop: Issue the initial assessment within the agreed hours of landfall or event confirmation.
Label the version with the footprint vintage and issue timestamp.
Reissue a new labelled version each time the footprint is updated.
Done when the initial assessment is issued on time and reissues follow footprint updates.
verify: Compare the initial issue timestamp to the event confirmation time.
Pass when the initial assessment issued within the agreed timeframe.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every location on the in-force exposure file submitted to the geocoding run.
generic.In-scope period: The current accumulation cycle, geocoded at the in-force as-at date before modelling.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Latitude, longitude and match-quality code written back to every location record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Geocoded record count equals the input location count plus the exception queue count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Geocoder vendor, reference data vintage and run timestamp recorded against the run.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Postcode-only, centroid-only and failed matches sit in the exception queue with a research owner.
generic.Test population: All location records in the geocoding run output.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the rooftop and street match rate is below the agreed minimum for release.
generic.Exception handling path: Failed and low-quality matches go to manual research and are re-run before modelling release.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every location carries coordinates and a match-quality code with vendor and data vintage recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Warehouse geocode output table and the exception queue for the accumulation cycle.

steps.title: Assemble the in-force location file from the policy administration system
sop: Extract all in-force locations with full address fields at the cycle as-at date.
Record the input record count for later reconciliation.
Confirm address fields are populated before submitting the file.
Done when the input file is assembled with its record count recorded.
verify: Compare the input record count to the in-force location control figure.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Run the file through the geocoding service
sop: Submit the full location file to the geocoding service.
Write latitude, longitude and match level back to each location record.
Record the geocoder vendor and reference data vintage for the run.
Done when the run completes with coordinates written back.
verify: Compare the output record count to the input record count.
Pass when output and input counts are equal.

steps.title: Classify locations by match quality
sop: Classify each location as rooftop, street, postcode or centroid match.
Keep the match-quality code on the location record in the warehouse.
Summarise the distribution of match quality for the run.
Done when every location carries a match-quality code.
verify: Query the output for records with a missing match-quality code.
Pass when the query returns zero rows.

steps.title: Route low-quality and failed matches to the exception queue
sop: Route postcode-only, centroid-only and failed matches to the exception queue.
Assign a research owner and a target date to each exception.
Re-run researched addresses through the geocoder.
Done when every low-quality or failed match sits in the queue with an owner.
verify: Compare the count of low-quality matches to the queue entry count.
Pass when the two counts agree.

steps.title: Confirm the match rate meets the release minimum
sop: Calculate the rooftop and street match rate for the run.
Compare the rate to the agreed minimum for release to modelling.
Hold the file back and continue research if the rate is below minimum.
Done when the match rate meets the agreed minimum.
verify: Recompute the rooftop and street match rate from the output table.
Pass when the recomputed rate meets or exceeds the minimum.

steps.title: Release the geocoded file for accumulation modelling
sop: Publish the geocoded file to the warehouse table used by accumulation modelling.
Stamp the vendor, reference data vintage and run timestamp on the release.
Notify the CAT modelling and portfolio reporting consumers.
Done when the stamped file is released and consumers are notified.
verify: Check the released table header for vendor, vintage and timestamp.
Pass when all three stamps are present on the release.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every peril zone with an approved capacity limit and a reinsurance program limit to monitor against.
generic.In-scope period: The current monitoring cycle using the latest completed accumulation run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Zone, current aggregate exposure, approved capacity, treaty limit, utilisation percentage and flag state.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Zone aggregate exposures in the monitor tie to the accumulation run they were sourced from.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Monitoring view retained with the accumulation run identifier and the monitoring date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Zones over limit carry a dated breach item naming the amount over and the driving policies.
generic.Test population: All monitored peril zones in the current cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a zone is shown over limit without a breach item or an in-date approved exception.
generic.Exception handling path: Breaches escalate to the Portfolio UW Manager and CUO on the day of identification.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Zonal utilisation view showing percentage of approved capacity used with warning and breach flags.
generic.Evidence location: Power BI zonal utilisation page and the breach log held with the CAT governance records.

steps.title: Load current zonal aggregates from the accumulation run
sop: Load current aggregate exposure per peril zone from the latest completed accumulation run.
Record the run identifier and the run completion timestamp.
Confirm every monitored zone is present in the run output.
Done when zonal aggregates are loaded from an identified run.
verify: Compare the monitored zone list to the run output zone list.
Pass when no monitored zone is missing from the run.

steps.title: Compare exposure to approved capacity and treaty limits
sop: Compare each zone aggregate to the approved zonal capacity and the reinsurance program limit.
Confirm the limits used are the current approved versions.
Show the tighter of the two limits as the binding constraint per zone.
Done when every zone is compared to both limits.
verify: Check the limit values against the signed capacity allocation.
Pass when the limits used match the signed allocation.

steps.title: Publish utilisation and flag states in Power BI
sop: Show utilisation as a percentage of the binding limit for each zone.
Flag zones in the warning band and zones in breach as distinct states.
Display the run identifier and monitoring date on the page.
Done when the utilisation view is published with flag states visible.
verify: Recompute utilisation for two zones from exposure and limit.
Pass when the recomputed percentages match the page.

steps.title: Raise a dated breach item for each zone over limit
sop: Raise a breach item for every zone above its binding limit.
State the zone, the amount over and the policies driving the excess.
Assign an owner and a target resolution date.
Done when every over-limit zone has a dated breach item.
verify: Compare the count of breached zones to the count of breach items.
Pass when the two counts are equal.

steps.title: Escalate breaches to the Portfolio UW Manager and CUO
sop: Escalate each breach on the day it is identified with the amount over and driving policies.
Agree the immediate containment action for each breach.
Record the escalation date and the agreed action.
Done when every breach is escalated on the identification date.
verify: Compare the escalation date to the identification date for each breach.
Pass when no breach was escalated later than its identification date.

steps.title: Review previously flagged zones for closure or exception
sop: Review zones flagged in the prior cycle against the current run.
Confirm each has returned within limit or carries an approved in-date exception.
Close resolved breach items with the closing exposure figure.
Done when every prior flag is closed, still open or covered by an exception.
verify: Check each prior flagged zone for closure or an in-date exception.
Pass when no prior flagged zone is left over limit without an in-date exception.

generic.Defined scope/population: All CRESTA zones with in-force exposure for each modelled peril, reported internally and to reinsurers.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting period covered by the accumulation run identified on the report.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: TIV, policy count, largest single location, modelled loss and gross, net of fac and net of treaty columns.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Report zone totals tie to the accumulation run and to the published zonal TIV table.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Both report versions retained with the shared run identifier and the report issue date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Zones with the largest period movement carry a written explanation of the driver.
generic.Test population: All zones on the internal and reinsurer versions of the report.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if internal-only commentary appears in the reinsurer version.
generic.Exception handling path: Formatting or content breaches in the reinsurer version return to the Portfolio Analyst before issue.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Internal and reinsurer reports produced from one run identifier showing gross, net of fac and net of treaty.
generic.Evidence location: CAT reporting folder holding both report versions and the run output they were built from.

steps.title: Extract the accumulation run output from the data warehouse
sop: Extract zone level TIV, policy count, largest single location and modelled loss for each modelled peril.
Record the accumulation run identifier used for the extract.
Confirm the extract covers every zone with in-force exposure.
Done when the run output is extracted with its run identifier recorded.
verify: Compare extracted zone TIV to the published zonal TIV table.
Pass when the two agree for every zone.

steps.title: Build the gross, net of fac and net of treaty columns
sop: Present gross, net of facultative and net of treaty columns for each zone and peril.
Apply the current facultative cessions and treaty structure to derive the net columns.
Show the ceded and retained split explicitly.
Done when all three column sets are present for every zone.
verify: Check net of treaty does not exceed gross in any zone row.
Pass when every row shows net at or below gross.

steps.title: Add period movement and explain the largest movers
sop: Add the movement versus the prior reporting period for each zone.
Write an explanation for the zones with the largest movements.
Attribute each movement to new business, non-renewal, revaluation or scheme change.
Done when movement and explanations for the largest movers are included.
verify: Check the largest movers each carry a written explanation.
Pass when no largest mover is left unexplained.

steps.title: Format the reinsurer version to the treaty layout
sop: Format the reinsurer version to the layout the treaty requires in Microsoft Excel.
Remove all internal-only commentary from the reinsurer version.
Complete every field the treaty layout mandates.
Done when the reinsurer version matches the treaty layout with no internal commentary.
verify: Search the reinsurer version for internal commentary fields.
Pass when no internal-only commentary is found.

steps.title: Publish the internal governance version in Power BI
sop: Publish the internal governance version with commentary and movement analysis.
Show the shared run identifier on both versions.
Confirm both versions carry identical zone figures.
Done when both versions are produced from the same run identifier.
verify: Compare zone figures across the internal and reinsurer versions.
Pass when the figures are identical in both versions.

steps.title: Review and issue both report versions
sop: Review both versions for accuracy, completeness and correct audience content.
Issue the internal version to governance and the reinsurer version through the agreed channel.
Record the issue date and recipients for each version.
Done when both versions are issued with issue dates recorded.
verify: Check the issue log for both versions and their recipients.
Pass when both versions show an issue date and recipient list.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every peak peril zone identified in the accumulation monitoring cycle and the policies driving it.
generic.In-scope period: The current remediation cycle from peak identification to the target implementation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Peak zone, driving policies, candidate levers, modelled relief, premium impact and preferred option recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Driving policy exposure sums to the peak zone contribution shown in the accumulation run.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Recommendation pack retained with the accumulation run identifier and the pack date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Peaks where no lever gives sufficient relief are escalated with the residual exposure stated.
generic.Test population: All peak zones in the recommendation pack.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a peak zone has no preferred option or no target implementation date.
generic.Exception handling path: Rejected recommendations return to exposure management with the reason and a revised option.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Pack listing peak-driving policies with candidate levers, modelled relief and premium impact for each.
generic.Evidence location: CAT remediation folder holding the recommendation pack and the recorded decision.

steps.title: Rank peak-driving policies by contribution to zonal PML
sop: Identify the specific locations and policies driving each concentration peak in the warehouse.
Rank them by contribution to zonal PML rather than by TIV alone.
Record the accumulation run identifier behind the ranking.
Done when a ranked driver list exists for every peak zone.
verify: Sum ranked driver contributions and compare to the zone PML.
Pass when the drivers account for the stated share of zone PML.

steps.title: Set out candidate levers per peak zone
sop: List the candidate levers for each peak: non-renewal, limit or line-size cut, higher deductible, facultative cession or new-business suspension.
Note contractual and regulatory constraints on each lever.
Exclude levers that cannot be executed within the cycle.
Done when each peak zone has a set of executable candidate levers.
verify: Check each peak zone lists at least one executable lever.
Pass when no peak zone is left without an executable lever.

steps.title: Quantify modelled relief and premium given up
sop: Model the exposure relief delivered by each candidate lever for its peak zone.
Quantify the premium given up under each option.
Present the relief and premium trade-off side by side.
Done when relief and premium impact are quantified for every lever.
verify: Check every listed lever carries a relief figure and a premium figure.
Pass when no lever is missing either figure.

steps.title: Recommend a preferred option with a target date
sop: Select the preferred option for each peak zone against the relief and premium trade-off.
Set the target implementation date allowing for notice periods and renewal timing.
State the residual exposure remaining after the preferred option.
Done when every peak zone has a preferred option and target date.
verify: Filter peak zones for a blank preferred option or target date.
Pass when no peak zone has either field blank.

steps.title: Route the pack to the Portfolio UW Manager and CUO for decision
sop: Circulate the recommendation pack for decision with the relief and premium trade-off visible.
Take the decision on each peak zone recommendation.
Record approve, amend or reject with the reason per zone.
Done when a decision is recorded for every peak zone.
verify: Check the decision record covers every peak zone in the pack.
Pass when no peak zone is left without a recorded decision.

steps.title: Hand approved actions to underwriting for execution
sop: Pass approved actions to the underwriting teams owning the affected accounts.
Set the referral or restriction in the underwriting workstation where the action requires it.
Confirm the execution owner and date for each action.
Done when every approved action has an execution owner and date.
verify: Check the underwriting workstation for the configured restrictions.
Pass when each approved action shows as configured or assigned for execution.

generic.Defined scope/population: Aggregate CAT exposure across all key perils reported to the CUO and risk management committee.

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Gross and net PML at agreed return periods, appetite comparison, reinsurance cover and open breach status.
