generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Report retained with the run identifier, model version and the committee meeting date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Open zonal breaches and approved exceptions are listed with status and expiry date.
generic.Test population: All perils and return periods presented in the quarterly report.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a reported PML figure cannot be traced to the cited accumulation run.
generic.Exception handling path: Figures that fail the tie-out are corrected and the report reissued before the committee.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Quarterly report of gross and net PML at agreed return periods against appetite and reinsurance cover.
generic.Evidence location: Risk management committee pack and the CAT governance folder holding the report and run output.

steps.title: Assemble PML results at the agreed return periods
sop: Assemble modelled PML at the agreed return periods for each key peril.
Present the figures gross and net of reinsurance.
Cite the accumulation run identifier and model version behind the figures.
Done when PML at all agreed return periods is assembled with its run cited.
verify: Trace two PML figures back to the cited run output.
Pass when both figures match the cited run.

steps.title: Compare aggregate exposure to board risk appetite
sop: Show aggregate CAT exposure against the board risk appetite thresholds.
Confirm the appetite version used is the current board-approved one.
Mark each peril as within, in warning or outside appetite.
Done when every key peril is positioned against board appetite.
verify: Check the appetite version cited against the board-approved record.
Pass when the cited version is the current approved version.

steps.title: Show cover against the reinsurance program structure
sop: Show net PML against the vertical and horizontal cover in the reinsurance program.
Identify perils where the modelled loss exceeds the vertical cover.
Show remaining horizontal cover for a multi-event year.
Done when cover adequacy is shown for each key peril.
verify: Check the program structure used against the placed treaty terms.
Pass when the structure shown matches the placed program.

steps.title: List open breaches and approved exceptions
sop: List every open zonal breach with its status, owner and target resolution date.
List approved exceptions with their expiry dates.
Flag exceptions expiring before the next quarterly report.
Done when all open breaches and exceptions are listed with status and expiry.
verify: Compare the list to the breach log for the quarter.
Pass when every open breach in the log appears in the report.

steps.title: Table the report at the risk management committee
sop: Table the CAT report at the quarterly risk management committee.
Take committee decisions on perils outside appetite and on exception extensions.
Confirm the actions, owners and deadlines arising.
Done when the report is tabled and decisions are taken.
verify: Check the committee agenda and minutes for the tabled report.
Pass when the minutes record the report as tabled with decisions.

steps.title: Record decisions and actions in the minutes
sop: Record committee decisions, owners and due dates in the minutes.
Update the CAT action log with the new and carried-forward items.
File the report and minutes together in the governance folder.
Done when decisions and actions are recorded and filed.
verify: Retrieve the minutes and the CAT action log for the quarter.
Pass when each decision has an owner and due date recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: The validated geocoded in-force exposure file run through the agreed peril and region scenario set.
generic.In-scope period: The current modelling cycle at the in-force as-at date of the loaded exposure file.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Model vendor, version, event set, demand surge and secondary uncertainty settings recorded with the results.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Loaded exposure record count and TIV match the source in-force file.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Run output retained with run identifier, model version and run completion timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Quarter-on-quarter movements above tolerance are explained as exposure, model or structure change.
generic.Test population: All peril and region scenarios in the agreed scenario set.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if PML or TVaR is missing on any of the gross, net of fac or net of treaty bases.
generic.Exception handling path: Failed or incomplete scenario runs are re-run before results are released to reporting.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: PML and TVaR at standard return periods on all three bases with model settings recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Catastrophe model run repository and the warehouse table holding the published run results.

steps.title: Load the validated exposure file into the catastrophe model
sop: Load the validated geocoded in-force exposure file into the catastrophe modelling platform.
Confirm the loaded record count and TIV match the source file.
Reject the load and return the file if the counts do not match.
Done when the exposure file is loaded with matching counts and TIV.
verify: Compare loaded record count and TIV to the source file control figures.
Pass when both match the source exactly.

steps.title: Configure the model settings for the run
sop: Set the event set, demand surge and secondary uncertainty settings per the agreed modelling standard.
Record the model vendor and version used.
Confirm the settings match those used for the prior comparable run unless a change is approved.
Done when the run settings are configured and recorded.
verify: Compare the configured settings against the modelling standard.
Pass when the settings match the standard or an approved deviation.

steps.title: Run the agreed peril and region scenario set
sop: Run every peril and region scenario in the agreed set.
Produce OEP and AEP curves with PML and TVaR at the standard return periods.
Re-run any scenario that fails or terminates early.
Done when every scenario in the set has completed successfully.
verify: Compare completed scenario count to the agreed scenario set.
Pass when every scenario in the set completed.

steps.title: Produce gross, net of fac and net of treaty results
sop: Apply the current facultative cessions and treaty structure to the run.
Produce results on gross, net of facultative and net of treaty bases.
Confirm the reinsurance structure used is the placed structure.
Done when results exist on all three bases for every scenario.
verify: Check net results do not exceed gross for any scenario.
Pass when all net results sit at or below gross.

steps.title: Attribute quarter-on-quarter movement
sop: Compare the run to the prior quarter run at the same return periods.
Explain movements above the agreed tolerance as exposure, model or structure change.
Quantify the contribution of each cause where more than one applies.
Done when every above-tolerance movement is attributed.
verify: Check each above-tolerance movement has a stated cause.
Pass when no above-tolerance movement is unattributed.

steps.title: Publish the run results with settings recorded
sop: Publish PML and TVaR results to the warehouse with the run identifier.
Record model vendor, version, event set and settings alongside the results.
Release the run for use in CAT reporting and capacity monitoring.
Done when the results are published with full settings recorded.
verify: Open the published run record and check the settings fields.
Pass when vendor, version, event set and settings are all recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: Per-risk and per-occurrence CAT limits and zonal sublimits across every line exposed to modelled perils.
generic.In-scope period: The treaty year from the limit schedule effective date to the next reinsurance renewal.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Per-risk limit, per-occurrence limit, zonal sublimit, effective date and approver present on the schedule.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Aggregate of zonal sublimits reconciles to the horizontal cover available for a multi-event year.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Limit schedule retained with version, effective date and the superseded schedule reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unplaced or co-reinsurance shortfall is recorded and reflected in the limits rather than ignored.
generic.Test population: All limits on the approved CAT limit schedule.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a bind above the loaded CAT limit is possible without referral in the underwriting workstation.
generic.Exception handling path: Risks above limit route to referral at the authority level the schedule states.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Approved schedule of per-risk, per-occurrence and zonal sublimits with an effective date reflecting placed cover.
generic.Evidence location: Reinsurance administration system treaty record and the limit schedule in the CAT governance folder.

steps.title: Confirm the placed reinsurance structure in the reinsurance system
sop: Extract the placed treaty structure with retention, layer limits and signed shares.
Identify any unplaced percentage or co-reinsurance shortfall.
Confirm the structure against the signed slip for the treaty year.
Done when the placed structure and any shortfall are confirmed.
verify: Compare the system structure to the signed slip.
Pass when the two agree including the placed percentage.

steps.title: Calibrate per-risk and per-occurrence limits to the retention
sop: Set per-risk and per-occurrence CAT limits so the retained position sits within treaty retention and appetite.
Reflect the unplaced or co-reinsurance shortfall in the retained calculation.
Show the retained position at each proposed limit.
Done when proposed per-risk and per-occurrence limits are calibrated to the retention.
verify: Recompute the retained position at the proposed limits.
Pass when the retained position sits within the treaty retention and appetite.

steps.title: Set zonal sublimits and check them against horizontal cover
sop: Set the zonal sublimits consistent with the approved capacity allocation.
Sum the sublimits and compare to the horizontal cover for a multi-event year.
Rework sublimits where the aggregate exceeds available horizontal cover.
Done when the sublimit aggregate sits within the horizontal cover.
verify: Recompute the sublimit aggregate against the horizontal cover.
Pass when the aggregate is at or below the horizontal cover.

steps.title: Approve the CAT limit schedule
sop: Review the proposed limit schedule against the placed program and appetite.
Record the approval decision and any conditions attached.
Set the effective date and supersede the prior schedule.
Done when the schedule is approved with an effective date set.
verify: Check the schedule for approver name, date and effective date.
Pass when all three are recorded on the approved schedule.

steps.title: Load the approved limits into the underwriting workstation
sop: Load the per-risk, per-occurrence and zonal limits into the underwriting workstation.
Set the workstation to block or refer binds above the loaded limits.
Deactivate the superseded limits on the effective date.
Done when the approved limits are active and the prior set is deactivated.
verify: Attempt a test bind above a loaded limit in the workstation.
Pass when the test bind is blocked or forced to referral.

steps.title: Publish the limit schedule and notify underwriting
sop: Publish the limit schedule with its version and effective date.
Notify underwriting teams and the reinsurance function of the new limits.
Mark the prior schedule as superseded in the governance folder.
Done when the schedule is published and the prior version is superseded.
verify: Check the governance folder for the live and superseded schedules.
Pass when only one schedule is marked live for the treaty year.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every location record on the in-force exposure file put through the location data-quality rule set.
generic.In-scope period: The current accumulation cycle validated at the in-force as-at date before modelling release.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Address, postcode, occupancy, construction, year built, storeys and building, contents and BI values present and in range.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every failed record is logged with a rule code and routed to the owning underwriter for correction.
generic.Test population: All location records in the in-force file for the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the published data-quality score is below the minimum threshold for release to modelling.
generic.Exception handling path: Failed records are held from modelling until corrected or explicitly accepted with a reason.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Published data-quality score with pass or fail against the minimum threshold for the file.
generic.Evidence location: Warehouse validation output and the data-quality issue tracker for the cycle.

steps.title: Extract the in-force location file from the policy administration system
sop: Extract every in-force location with address, occupancy, construction and value fields at the cycle as-at date.
Record the extract record count and as-at date.
Confirm the extract covers all lines writing property exposure.
Done when the file is extracted with its record count recorded.
verify: Compare the extract count to the in-force location control figure.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Run the location data-quality rule set
sop: Run the rule set for address completeness, valid postcode and approved occupancy and construction codes.
Run the plausibility rules for year built and number of storeys.
Record the rule set version applied to the run.
Done when every rule has run against every location record.
verify: Compare records tested to records in the input file.
Pass when every input record was tested by the rule set.

steps.title: Check TIV completeness and value composition in Microsoft Excel
sop: Flag missing or default TIV values across the location file.
Check that building, contents and business interruption values sum to the policy TIV.
List locations where the components do not reconcile.
Done when TIV completeness and composition are checked for every location.
verify: Recompute the component sum for a sample of ten locations.
Pass when the sampled sums equal the policy TIV.

steps.title: Detect duplicate locations across policies
sop: Detect duplicate locations by address match and coordinate proximity.
Distinguish genuine shared locations from data entry duplicates.
Flag data entry duplicates for correction in the policy system.
Done when duplicates are identified and classified.
verify: Review a sample of flagged duplicates against the policy records.
Pass when the sampled flags are correctly classified.

steps.title: Log failed records to the data-quality issue tracker
sop: Log every failed record with its rule code to the data-quality issue tracker.
Route each issue to the owning underwriter for correction.
Set a correction target date for each logged issue.
Done when every failed record has a tracker entry with an owner.
verify: Compare the failed record count to the tracker entry count.
Pass when the two counts agree.

steps.title: Publish the data-quality score and release the file
sop: Calculate and publish the data-quality score for the in-force file.
Compare the score to the minimum threshold for release to modelling.
Hold the file back if the score is below threshold and rerun after correction.
Done when the score is published and meets the release threshold.
verify: Read the published score against the minimum threshold.
Pass when the score meets or exceeds the threshold before release.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every segment identified as exceeding its concentration limit and requiring a binding restriction.

steps.title: Define the restriction scope for each over-limit segment

Set the effective date and the scheduled review date.

steps.title: Configure the block or referral rule in the underwriting workstation
sop: Configure the binding block or referral rule for each restricted segment.

Record the change reference in the workstation audit trail.
Done when the rule is configured and dated for every restricted segment.
verify: Inspect the workstation rule list for each restricted segment.
Pass when every restricted segment shows an active configured rule.

steps.title: Set the referral path to the Portfolio UW Manager
sop: Route restricted risks to the Portfolio UW Manager rather than an automatic decline.
Confirm the referral queue is monitored and has a response service level.
Set the escalation path if the referral is not actioned in time.
Done when the referral path and escalation are configured.
verify: Trigger a referral on a test risk and check the queue it lands in.
Pass when the test referral reaches the Portfolio UW Manager queue.

steps.title: Test the rule on a sample submission
sop: Enter a sample submission in the restricted segment in the underwriting workstation.
Confirm the submission is stopped or referred as intended.
Enter a control submission outside the restricted scope and confirm it proceeds.
Done when both the restricted and control test results are as expected.
verify: Review the two test results against the intended rule behaviour.
Pass when the restricted test is stopped and the control test proceeds.

steps.title: Confirm the policy administration system honours the restriction
sop: Check that a restricted risk cannot be issued in the policy administration system without a referral record.
Confirm renewals are treated per the stated restriction scope.
Record the check result against the restriction register.
Done when the policy system behaviour matches the restriction scope.
verify: Attempt a test issue of a restricted risk in the policy system.
Pass when the test issue is blocked or requires a referral record.

steps.title: Notify affected underwriters and distribution
sop: Notify affected underwriters and distribution of the restriction and its effective date.
State the exception route and who can approve an exception.
Record the notification date and recipients on the restriction register.
Done when the notification is issued before the effective date.
verify: Compare the notification date to the effective date.
Pass when the notification preceded the effective date.

generic.Defined scope/population: All bound and quoted new-business pipeline records added to the in-force exposure base for re-aggregation.

generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Pipeline exposure added reconciles to the underwriting workstation pipeline totals.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assessment saved with the in-force as-at date, the pipeline extract date and the hit-ratio assumption used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Accounts consuming more than the agreed share of remaining headroom are individually flagged with an owner.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Marginal new-business impact on zonal and segment aggregate shown alongside the in-force base at plan hit ratio.

steps.title: Extract the pipeline from the underwriting workstation
sop: Extract bound and quoted new business with exposure, zone and segment attributes.
Record the pipeline extract date and the quote status of each record.
Exclude lapsed and declined quotes from the pipeline base.
Done when the pipeline extract is loaded with statuses recorded.
verify: Compare extracted pipeline totals to the workstation pipeline report.
Pass when the two totals agree.

steps.title: Add the pipeline to the in-force exposure base
sop: Add the pipeline records to the in-force exposure base in the warehouse.
Re-run the zonal and segment aggregation on the combined base.
Keep the in-force and pipeline contributions separable in the output.
Done when the combined aggregation is produced with contributions separable.
verify: Check the combined base equals in-force plus pipeline exposure.
Pass when the combined total reconciles to its two components.

steps.title: Show marginal contribution by zone and segment
sop: Calculate the marginal contribution of new business to each zone and segment.
Present marginal contribution alongside the post-bind total rather than instead of it.
Rank zones and segments by marginal contribution.
Done when marginal contribution is shown for every affected zone and segment.
verify: Check the marginal figures sum to the total pipeline exposure.
Pass when the marginal contributions reconcile to the pipeline total.

steps.title: Test zones and segments at plan hit ratio
sop: Apply the plan hit ratio to the quoted pipeline to model expected conversion.
Identify zones or segments that would enter the warning band or exceed limit.
State the hit-ratio assumption used on the output.
Done when the converted-position test is complete for every affected zone.
verify: Recompute one zone converted position from pipeline and hit ratio.
Pass when the recomputed position matches the output.

steps.title: Report the diversification effect
sop: Identify which new business reduces concentration and which compounds it.
Quantify the diversification effect per zone and segment.
Highlight pipeline that improves the portfolio position for prioritisation.
Done when the diversification effect is reported for every affected zone.
verify: Check each affected zone carries a diversification classification.
Pass when no affected zone is left unclassified.

steps.title: Flag headroom-consuming accounts and refer at-risk zones
sop: Flag pipeline accounts consuming more than the agreed share of remaining headroom.
Refer zones that would move over limit at plan conversion to exposure management.
Record the flag, referral and decision against each account.
Done when every flagged account and at-risk zone has a recorded decision.
verify: Check flagged accounts and at-risk zones for a recorded decision.
Pass when no flagged item is left without a decision.

generic.Defined scope/population: Portfolio share by industry class, geography, limit band and single-insured aggregation against appetite parameters.
generic.In-scope period: The current monitoring period compared against the prior period position.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Dimension, current share, prior share, drift amount, driving accounts, owner and review date present per flag.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Dimension shares sum to 100 percent of the measured portfolio base.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Watchlist saved with the appetite parameter version and the data-as-at date used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every dimension breaching the drift tolerance is added to the watchlist with an owner and review date.
generic.Test population: All measured dimensions in the concentration monitoring output.

generic.Exception handling path: Flags without driving accounts attached return to the Portfolio Analyst before the watchlist is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Watchlist entries for every dimension breaching drift tolerance with driving accounts, owner and review date.
generic.Evidence location: Portfolio watchlist record and the Power BI concentration drift page.

steps.title: Measure current share by each appetite dimension
sop: Measure current share by industry class, geography, limit band and single-insured aggregation.
Use the appetite parameter version in force for the period.
Confirm the shares sum to the full portfolio base.
Done when current share is measured on every appetite dimension.
verify: Sum shares within each dimension.
Pass when each dimension sums to the full portfolio base.

steps.title: Compare against appetite parameters and prior period
sop: Compare each share to its appetite parameter and to the prior period value.
Calculate the drift since the prior period for each dimension.
Mark dimensions inside limit that have still drifted materially.
Done when drift and appetite position are calculated for every dimension.
verify: Recompute drift for two dimensions from current and prior shares.
Pass when the recomputed drift matches the output.

steps.title: Flag dimensions breaching the drift tolerance
sop: Flag every dimension that moved more than the agreed drift tolerance.
Include dimensions that remain within limit but are drifting toward it.
Rank flags by size of drift and premium affected.
Done when all breaching dimensions are flagged and ranked.
verify: Compare flagged dimensions to those exceeding the tolerance.
Pass when the flagged set matches the breaching set.

steps.title: Classify drift as growth-driven or shrinkage-driven
sop: Distinguish drift caused by new business growth from drift caused by shrinkage elsewhere.
Show the absolute movement behind each share change.
State the classification on every flag.
Done when every flag carries a growth or shrinkage classification.
verify: Check each flag for a stated classification.
Pass when no flag lacks a classification.

steps.title: Attach the driving policies or accounts to each flag
sop: Attach the driving policies or accounts to each flag from the warehouse.
Rank the drivers by contribution to the drift.
Ensure the recipient can act without re-running the analysis.
Done when every flag carries its driving accounts.
verify: Check each flag for an attached driver list.
Pass when no flag is issued without driving accounts.

steps.title: Add flags to the portfolio watchlist with owner and review date
sop: Add each flag to the portfolio watchlist with an owner and a review date.
Agree the owner with exposure management where the flag is peril-zone related.
Carry unresolved prior flags forward with an updated status.
Done when every flag sits on the watchlist with an owner and review date.
verify: Check watchlist entries for blank owner or review date.
Pass when no watchlist entry has either field blank.

generic.Defined scope/population: Emerging portfolio trends material enough to justify an appetite or guideline change rather than routine monitoring.

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Observed movement, periods persisted, premium and exposure affected, proposed parameter change and response.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Premium and exposure quoted per trend ties to the portfolio performance analysis for the same period.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any shortlisted item has no recorded accept, defer or reject response.
generic.Exception handling path: Rejected items return to monitoring with the rejection reason recorded against the trend.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Shortlist with a proposed appetite or guideline change and a recorded response for each item.
generic.Evidence location: Appetite review record holding the shortlist and the CUO responses.

steps.title: Select trends that justify an appetite change in Power BI
sop: Review the flagged trends from performance, concentration and CAT analysis.
Select only those material and persistent enough to justify an appetite or guideline change.
Exclude items that routine monitoring already covers.
Done when the shortlist of change-worthy trends is drawn.
verify: Trace each shortlisted trend back to its source analysis.
Pass when every item traces to a flagged trend.

steps.title: State the movement and persistence for each trend
sop: State the observed movement and the number of periods it has persisted over.
Quantify the premium and exposure affected by each trend.
Show the trend line rather than a single point value.
Done when movement, persistence and affected volume are stated per item.
verify: Check every item shows movement, persistence and affected volume.
Pass when no item is missing any of the three.

steps.title: Propose the specific parameter change in Microsoft Excel
sop: Name the specific guideline or appetite parameter that would change for each item.
State the expected portfolio effect of the change.
Note any reinsurance or capital dependency on the change.
Done when every item carries a named proposed parameter change.
verify: Check each item names a specific parameter and expected effect.
Pass when no item proposes a change without naming the parameter.

steps.title: Present the shortlist to the Chief Underwriting Officer
sop: Present the shortlist to the CUO with the evidence behind each item.
Take questions and supply supporting analysis where challenged.
Confirm which items proceed to formal appetite change.
Done when every shortlisted item has been put to the CUO.
verify: Compare items presented to items on the shortlist.
Pass when every shortlisted item was presented.

steps.title: Record accept, defer or reject against each item
sop: Record accept, defer or reject for each shortlisted item.
State the reason for defer and reject responses.
Name the owner and the next step for accepted items.
Done when every item carries a recorded response.
verify: Filter the shortlist for items without a response.
Pass when no item is left without a recorded response.

steps.title: Carry deferred items to the next appetite review agenda
sop: Add every deferred item to the next quarterly appetite review agenda.
Record the deferral reason and the review date.
Refresh the supporting analysis before the next review.
Done when all deferred items are on the next agenda.
verify: Compare deferred items to the next review agenda.
Pass when every deferred item appears on the agenda.

generic.Defined scope/population: All in-force policies measured by written premium and TIV share across class, geography, limit band and channel.

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Class, geography, limit band, channel, share value, appetite target range and status marker on every row.

steps.title: Measure premium and TIV share by each dimension

Confirm shares reconcile to the total base for each dimension.

verify: Sum shares in each dimension against the total base.

steps.title: Load the current appetite target ranges
sop: Load the target range for each dimension from the current appetite statement.

Confirm every measured dimension has a target range.
Done when target ranges are loaded from the current statement.
verify: Check the loaded ranges against the current appetite statement.

steps.title: Mark each share within, warning or outside range

Sort the view so out-of-range rows surface first.
Done when every share carries a status marker.
verify: Check status markers against the target ranges for sampled rows.
Pass when the sampled markers match the range comparison.

steps.title: Add the four-period trend for each share
sop: Add the value of each share for the last four periods.
Show the direction of travel alongside the point value.
Highlight shares moving toward a range boundary.
Done when every share carries a four-period trend.
verify: Check the trend covers four consecutive periods for each share.
Pass when no share shows fewer than four periods.

steps.title: Check for prohibited classes and no-write list entries
sop: Test every in-force policy against the prohibited class list and the no-write list.
Refer any hit to underwriting management immediately.
Record the referral and outcome against the policy.
Done when the prohibited and no-write checks are complete.
verify: Query in-force policies against the prohibited and no-write lists.
Pass when the query returns zero rows or all hits carry referrals.

steps.title: Publish the composition view on the monthly cycle
sop: Review the composition view before publication.
Publish on the agreed monthly cycle with the appetite statement version referenced.
Notify underwriting management of the out-of-range dimensions.
Done when the view is published on cycle with the version referenced.
verify: Check the published page for the appetite version and as-at date.
Pass when both appear on the published page.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every risk category, peril zone and limit band with an approved capacity limit to report utilisation against.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting period to date with a projection to year end at the current run rate.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Consumed capacity, remaining headroom, approved limit, utilisation percentage and projection present per category.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Consumed capacity plus remaining headroom equals the approved limit for every category.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Report published with the data-as-at date and the version of the appetite limits used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Categories with negative headroom are listed separately with the amount over and any exception reference.
generic.Test population: All risk categories, peril zones and limit bands in the utilisation report.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if consumed plus headroom does not equal the approved limit for any category.
generic.Exception handling path: Negative headroom without an exception reference is escalated to the Portfolio UW Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Utilisation report with consumed capacity, remaining headroom and year-end projection by risk category.
generic.Evidence location: Power BI appetite utilisation page and the workbook held in the portfolio reporting folder.

steps.title: Load approved limits and current consumption from the warehouse
sop: Load the approved limit for each risk category, peril zone and limit band.
Load current consumed capacity for the same categories from the warehouse.
Record the appetite limit version and the data-as-at date.
Done when limits and consumption are loaded for every category.
verify: Check every category with a limit also has a consumption figure.
Pass when no category is missing either value.

steps.title: Calculate remaining headroom per category
sop: Calculate remaining headroom as approved limit less consumed capacity.
Confirm consumed plus headroom equals the approved limit in every row.
Record negative headroom rather than flooring the value at zero.
Done when headroom is calculated for every category.
verify: Test consumed plus headroom against the limit for all rows.
Pass when the identity holds for every row.

steps.title: Express utilisation in amount and percentage with warning shading
sop: Express utilisation as an absolute amount and as a percentage of limit.
Shade the warning band on the report so approaching categories stand out.
Sort categories by utilisation percentage descending.
Done when both measures and the warning shading are present.
verify: Recompute utilisation percentage for two categories.
Pass when the recomputed percentages match the report.

steps.title: Project utilisation to year end at the current run rate
sop: Project each category to year end using the current run rate.
Flag categories on course to breach before year end.
State the run-rate basis used for the projection.
Done when a year-end projection exists for every category.
verify: Recompute one projection from consumption to date and elapsed period.
Pass when the recomputed projection matches the report.

steps.title: List negative-headroom categories separately
sop: List categories with negative headroom in a separate section.
State the amount over limit for each.
Attach the approved exception reference where one exists.
Done when every negative-headroom category is listed with its amount over.
verify: Compare negative-headroom categories to the separate listing.
Pass when every such category appears with an amount over.

steps.title: Publish the utilisation report with as-at date and limit version
sop: Review the report for reasonableness before publication.
Publish with the data-as-at date and appetite limit version stated.
Escalate categories projected to breach before year end.
Done when the report is published with date and limit version stated.
verify: Open the published report and check the header fields.
Pass when as-at date and limit version are both present.

generic.Defined scope/population: Portfolio composition, appetite utilisation, open breaches and prior actions put to the underwriting governance committee.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting quarter, matching the quarterly portfolio review pack for the same quarter.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Composition, utilisation, breach status, prior-action rating, decision, owner and due date completed.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Headline figures in the committee paper match the quarterly portfolio review pack.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Committee paper and minutes retained with the meeting date and paper version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items needing an appetite change or exception extension carry an explicit committee decision.
generic.Test population: All items in the quarterly committee paper.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a prior action has no red, amber or green status in the paper.
generic.Exception handling path: Items deferred by the committee carry a new due date and are re-tabled at the next meeting.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Quarterly paper covering composition, utilisation, open breaches and prior-action status.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting governance committee pack and minutes with the portfolio action log.

steps.title: Assemble the committee paper in Microsoft Excel
sop: Assemble portfolio composition, appetite utilisation and open breaches into the committee paper.
Use the same quarter data as the quarterly portfolio review pack.
Keep the paper to the committee's standard structure.
Done when all required sections are assembled.
verify: Check the paper contents against the standard committee structure.
Pass when no required section is missing.

steps.title: Add prior-action status with a RAG rating
sop: List every action raised at the previous committee.
Add a red, amber or green rating and current status to each.
Show the owner and due date against each open action.
Done when every prior action carries a rating and status.
verify: Compare prior action count to rated actions in the paper.
Pass when every prior action carries a rating.

steps.title: Cross-check headline figures against the quarterly pack
sop: Compare headline premium, loss ratio and utilisation to the quarterly portfolio review pack.
Resolve any difference before the paper is issued.
Record the cross-check as complete on the paper.
Done when the headline figures agree with the quarterly pack.
verify: Re-run the comparison after any correction.
Pass when the paper and the pack agree on the headline figures.

steps.title: Identify items requiring an explicit committee decision
sop: Mark items requiring an appetite change or an exception extension.
State the specific decision sought for each marked item.
Attach the supporting evidence for each decision request.
Done when every decision item states the decision sought.
verify: Check marked items for a stated decision request.
Pass when no marked item lacks a decision request.

steps.title: Present the paper to the governance committee
sop: Present composition, utilisation, breaches and prior actions to the committee.
Seek explicit decisions on the marked items.
Answer challenge with the attached supporting evidence.
Done when the paper is presented and decisions are sought.
verify: Check the committee agenda records the paper as presented.
Pass when the agenda and minutes show the paper presented.

steps.title: Record decisions, owners and due dates in the minutes
sop: Confirm the committee decision on each item requiring action.
Record the decision, owner and due date in the minutes.
Direct the update of the portfolio action log.
Done when every action item has a decision, owner and due date.
verify: Compare the minutes against the action log entries.
Pass when each action has a decision, owner and due date recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every treaty layer in the current treaty year with an occurrence limit, aggregate limit or reinstatement provision.
generic.In-scope period: The current treaty year to date as defined by the signed slip inception and expiry.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Layer, occurrence limit, aggregate limit, reinstatements used and remaining, and aggregate deductible erosion.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Ceded and retained exposure tracked ties to the reinsurance system ceded position for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Tracker retained with the treaty year, slip version and the data-as-at date used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Layers below the agreed remaining-capacity warning level carry a dated escalation.
generic.Test population: All treaty layers active in the current treaty year.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the treaty terms used do not match the signed slip for the treaty year.
generic.Exception handling path: Appetite consumed beyond supporting cover is referred to the Portfolio UW Manager and reinsurance.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Tracker showing occurrence and aggregate usage, deductible erosion and remaining reinstatements for the treaty year.
generic.Evidence location: Power BI treaty capacity page sourced from the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Extract treaty terms from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Extract layer structure, occurrence limits, aggregate limits and reinstatement provisions for the treaty year.
Confirm the extracted terms match the signed slip.
Record the slip version and treaty year on the extract.
Done when treaty terms are extracted and matched to the slip.
verify: Compare extracted terms to the signed slip for two layers.
Pass when both layers match the slip exactly.

steps.title: Track ceded and retained exposure against each layer
sop: Track ceded and retained exposure against each layer's occurrence and aggregate limits.
Source the ceded position from the reinsurance system rather than estimates.
Confirm the exposure basis matches the treaty definition.
Done when ceded and retained exposure is tracked for every layer.
verify: Compare tracked ceded exposure to the reinsurance system position.
Pass when the tracker and the system agree.

steps.title: Show aggregate deductible erosion and remaining reinstatements
sop: Show aggregate deductible erosion for the treaty year to date.
Show reinstatements used and remaining capacity for each layer.
State the events that drove the erosion.
Done when erosion and reinstatement capacity are shown per layer.
verify: Recompute erosion from the recorded event losses.
Pass when the recomputed erosion matches the tracker.

steps.title: Compare appetite utilisation with treaty capacity
sop: Overlay appetite utilisation on treaty capacity by class and zone.
Identify where appetite is consumed beyond the cover supporting it.
Quantify the unsupported portion.
Done when the appetite and treaty capacity comparison is produced.
verify: Check that every appetite category maps to a supporting treaty layer.
Pass when no appetite category is left without a mapped layer or a flag.

steps.title: Escalate layers below the remaining-capacity warning level
sop: Identify layers with remaining aggregate capacity below the agreed warning level.
Escalate each with the remaining capacity and the driving events.
Agree the containment or reinstatement action with reinsurance.
Done when every warning-level layer is escalated with an agreed action.
verify: Compare warning-level layers to the escalation log.
Pass when every warning-level layer has a dated escalation.

steps.title: Publish the treaty capacity tracker in Power BI
sop: Publish the tracker showing limit usage, erosion and reinstatements per layer.
Stamp the treaty year, slip version and data-as-at date on the page.
Refresh the page on the agreed monitoring cycle.
Done when the tracker is published and stamped.
verify: Open the published page and check the stamps and layer coverage.
Pass when all active layers appear with the stamps present.

generic.Defined scope/population: New-business submission, quote and bound activity in every segment carrying an active binding restriction.
generic.In-scope period: The measurement period spanning equal windows before and after the restriction effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Submission, quote and bound counts, aggregate exposure, exception count and approval reference per segment.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Bound volume in the restricted segment reconciles between the workstation and the warehouse.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Effectiveness analysis retained with the measurement window dates and the restriction reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every exception granted is checked for the required approval and logged with its approver.
generic.Test population: All new business in restricted segments across the measurement period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if business was bound in a restricted segment with neither an override record nor an approved exception.
generic.Exception handling path: Leakage cases are investigated for cause and referred to underwriting management for correction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Before-and-after volume and exposure comparison with a maintain, ease or tighten recommendation.
generic.Evidence location: Restriction register entry holding the effectiveness analysis and its Power BI view.

steps.title: Measure volumes before and after the effective date
sop: Measure submission, quote and bound volume in the restricted segment for equal windows either side of the effective date.
Use the warehouse and the underwriting workstation as matched sources.
State the window lengths used on the analysis.
Done when before and after volumes are measured for every restricted segment.
verify: Compare workstation and warehouse bound counts for the segment.
Pass when the two sources agree.

steps.title: Quantify the change in aggregate exposure
sop: Measure the restricted segment aggregate exposure before and after the restriction.
Confirm the movement is in the intended direction and quantify it.
Separate restriction effect from renewal and revaluation effects.
Done when the exposure change is quantified and attributed.
verify: Recompute the exposure change from the two period positions.
Pass when the recomputed change matches the analysis.

steps.title: Count exceptions and check their approvals
sop: Count exceptions granted against the restriction in the measurement period.
Check each exception carried the required approval before binding.
List exceptions lacking approval as findings.
Done when every exception is counted and its approval checked.
verify: Compare exception count to approval records held.
Pass when every exception has a matching approval record or a finding.

steps.title: Identify leakage bound without block or referral
sop: Identify business bound in the restricted segment that was neither blocked nor referred.
Investigate whether the cause was rule scope, data coding or an override.
Record the leakage cases with their cause.
Done when all leakage cases are identified and causes recorded.
verify: Cross-check bound policies against block and referral records.
Pass when every bound policy has a block, referral or logged leakage case.

steps.title: Correct the rule where leakage was caused by configuration
sop: Fix the rule scope or coding gap that allowed leakage in the underwriting workstation.
Retest the corrected rule with a sample submission.
Record the correction and retest against the restriction register.
Done when configuration-caused leakage is corrected and retested.
verify: Submit a test risk that previously leaked through.
Pass when the test risk is now blocked or referred.

steps.title: Recommend maintain, ease or tighten
sop: Review the volume, exposure, exception and leakage evidence at the end of the measurement period.
Recommend maintain, ease or tighten with the supporting numbers.
Set the next review date for the restriction.
Done when a recommendation and next review date are recorded.
verify: Check the recommendation cites the measured volume and exposure change.
Pass when the recommendation is supported by the recorded numbers.

generic.Defined scope/population: Pricing loss ratio, frequency and severity assumptions for every segment with credible developed experience.
generic.In-scope period: The accident or underwriting periods covered by the current actuarial development and trend review.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Assumption value, actual experience, variance, credibility view and agreed change present per segment.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Actual experience used ties to the developed loss data in the actuarial modeling platform.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Validation record retained with the actuarial data version and the agreement date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Segments outside assumption tolerance are recorded as credible change or noise with the reasoning.
generic.Test population: All segments compared in the assumption validation.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if an agreed assumption change has no effective pricing cycle recorded.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed segments are re-examined jointly with actuarial before the assumption is carried forward.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Documented validation showing assumption versus actual by segment and the agreed changes with an effective cycle.
generic.Evidence location: Assumption validation record held with the pricing and planning cycle documentation.

steps.title: Extract pricing assumptions and developed experience
sop: Extract the loss ratio, frequency and severity assumptions used in pricing by segment.
Extract the developed experience for the same segments from the actuarial modeling platform.
Align the periods and cohort definitions between the two sets.
Done when assumptions and developed experience are aligned by segment.
verify: Check every priced segment has matching developed experience.
Pass when no priced segment lacks an experience comparison.

steps.title: Compare assumption against actual by segment
sop: Compare each assumption against the emerging developed experience.
Calculate the variance and express it against the assumption tolerance.
Rank segments by size of variance and premium affected.
Done when variance to assumption is calculated for every segment.
verify: Recompute variance for two segments from assumption and actual.
Pass when the recomputed variances match the analysis.

steps.title: Review development factors and trend assumptions with actuarial
sop: Review the loss development factors and trend assumptions actuarial applied.
State the underwriting view of any large-loss distortion in the data.
Agree how large losses are treated in the comparison.
Done when the factor and trend basis is reviewed and the large-loss treatment agreed.
verify: Check the agreed large-loss treatment is recorded.
Pass when the treatment is documented and applied in the comparison.

steps.title: Classify out-of-tolerance segments as credible or noise
sop: Identify segments where actual experience sits outside the assumption tolerance.
Agree with actuarial whether each is credible change or statistical noise.
Record the reasoning behind each classification.
Done when every out-of-tolerance segment is classified.
verify: Check out-of-tolerance segments for a recorded classification.
Pass when no such segment is left unclassified.

steps.title: Agree the assumption changes for the next cycle
sop: Agree with actuarial the assumption changes to carry into the next pricing and planning cycle.
State the new value and the segment affected for each change.
Confirm the changes are deliverable within the cycle timetable.
Done when the assumption changes are agreed and stated.
verify: Check each agreed change names a segment and a new value.
Pass when no agreed change is missing either.

steps.title: Document the agreed position and effective pricing cycle
sop: Document the agreed position, the segments changed and the effective pricing cycle.
Attach the assumption versus actual comparison as supporting evidence.
File the record with the pricing and planning cycle documentation.
Done when the validation record is documented and filed.
verify: Retrieve the validation record and check for the effective cycle.
Pass when the record states the effective pricing cycle for each change.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every underwriting guideline version retired from active use and moved to the historical archive.
generic.In-scope period: The effective-from and effective-to dates of each retired guideline version.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Version number, effective-from, effective-to, approver, rationale and superseding version link recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Archived version count matches the count of versions retired in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Read-only archive entry holding the document, its approval record and its version dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Retired versions missing an approval record are logged and the gap researched before archiving.
generic.Test population: All guideline versions archived in the period plus a point-in-time retrieval sample.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a point-in-time retrieval does not return the guideline in force on the chosen date.
generic.Exception handling path: Failed retrievals return to the Portfolio Analyst to correct the version dating in the archive.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Read-only archived versions with version number, effective dates, approval record and superseding link.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting records archive in the enterprise data warehouse with the version index.

steps.title: Identify guideline versions retired in the period
sop: List every guideline version retired or superseded in the period.
Confirm each has been removed from active use before archiving.
Record the retirement date against each version.
Done when the list of retired versions is complete with dates.
verify: Compare the list to the guideline change log for the period.
Pass when every superseded version in the log appears on the list.

steps.title: Archive each version with its effective dates
sop: Archive each retired guideline document with its version number.
Record the effective-from and effective-to dates on the archive entry.
Confirm the dates leave no gap or overlap with adjacent versions.
Done when every retired version is archived with effective dates.
verify: Check adjacent version dates for gaps or overlaps.
Pass when the version dates form a continuous chain.

steps.title: Link each retired version to its superseding version
sop: Link every retired version to the version that superseded it.
Confirm the chain is traceable from the earliest version to the live one.
Record the link reference on both entries.
Done when the change chain is traceable end to end.
verify: Walk the chain from an early version to the live version.
Pass when the walk completes without a broken link.

steps.title: Preserve the approval record with the archived version
sop: Attach the approver, approval date and rationale to each archived version.
Research and record any missing approval evidence before closing the entry.
Log versions where approval evidence cannot be found.
Done when every archived version carries its approval record or a logged gap.
verify: Check archived versions for an attached approval record.
Pass when every version has an approval record or a logged gap.

steps.title: Set the archive read-only with the retention class
sop: Set each archive entry to read-only in Microsoft Excel and the warehouse store.
Apply the underwriting records retention class to the entry.
Set the disposal date derived from the retention class.
Done when entries are read-only with retention class and disposal date set.
verify: Attempt an edit on an archived entry and read the retention fields.
Pass when the edit is blocked and the retention fields are set.

steps.title: Spot-check point-in-time retrieval
sop: Choose a past date and retrieve the guideline in force on that date.
Confirm the retrieved version matches the effective date range.
Record the spot-check result against the archive.
Done when the spot-check returns the correct in-force version.
verify: Compare the retrieved version dates to the chosen date.
Pass when the retrieved version was in force on that date.

generic.Defined scope/population: All external changes in the period covering product launches, regulatory changes, court decisions and market dislocation.
generic.In-scope period: The assessment period feeding the current quarterly appetite review agenda.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: External change, affected appetite parameters, premium and exposure at stake and recommendation recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Premium and exposure at stake per parameter ties to the portfolio position for the same period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assessment retained with the source references for each external change and the assessment date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Changes with no identifiable appetite impact are recorded as no change with the reasoning.
generic.Test population: All external changes listed in scope for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if an external change is listed without a mapped appetite parameter or a recommendation.
generic.Exception handling path: Amend recommendations feed the quarterly appetite review rather than being actioned directly.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assessment mapping each change to affected parameters with volume at stake and a recommendation.
generic.Evidence location: Appetite review folder holding the external impact assessment and its source references.

steps.title: List the external changes in scope for the period
sop: List new product launches, regulatory and filing changes, court decisions and market dislocations in the period.
Record the source reference and date for each change.
Exclude changes already assessed in a prior period unless they have moved.
Done when the in-scope external change list is complete with sources.
verify: Check each listed change carries a source reference and date.
Pass when no listed change lacks either.

steps.title: Map each change to the appetite parameters it affects
sop: Map each external change to the specific class, geography, limit, attachment or deductible parameters affected.
Note where a change affects no appetite parameter and record it as no change.
Confirm the parameter names match the current appetite statement.
Done when every change is mapped to parameters or recorded as no change.
verify: Check each change carries a parameter mapping or a no-change record.
Pass when no change is left unmapped.

steps.title: Quantify premium and exposure at stake
sop: Quantify the premium and exposure at stake for each affected parameter using the warehouse position.
Show the in-force and pipeline components separately.
State the data-as-at date used for the quantification.
Done when volume at stake is quantified for every affected parameter.
verify: Compare quantified volumes to the portfolio position for the period.
Pass when the quantified volumes tie to the portfolio position.

steps.title: Recommend no change, monitor or amend per parameter
sop: Recommend no change, monitor or amend for each affected parameter.
State the reasoning behind each recommendation.
Note any reinsurance or capital dependency on an amend recommendation.
Done when every affected parameter carries a recommendation and reasoning.
verify: Filter affected parameters for a missing recommendation.
Pass when no affected parameter is left without one.

steps.title: Review the assessment with the Chief Underwriting Officer
sop: Review the mapped changes, volumes at stake and recommendations.
Challenge recommendations that do not follow from the evidence.
Confirm which amend recommendations proceed to the appetite review.
Done when the assessment is reviewed and the amend list is confirmed.
verify: Check the confirmed amend list against the assessment recommendations.
Pass when the amend list is consistent with the reviewed recommendations.

steps.title: Feed amend recommendations into the appetite review agenda
sop: Add each confirmed amend recommendation to the quarterly appetite review agenda.
Attach the assessment evidence to the agenda item.
Record the agenda reference against the assessment.
Done when every amend recommendation appears on the agenda.
verify: Compare the amend list to the appetite review agenda.
Pass when every amend item appears on the agenda.

generic.Defined scope/population: All underwriters and managers in the lines affected by the configured appetite rule change.
generic.In-scope period: From the change note issue date to the appetite rule effective date and the transition window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Before and after values, effective date, referral trigger, referral recipient and transition treatment stated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Acknowledgement count matches the affected underwriter and manager population.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dated change note retained with its version and the intranet publication record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Non-acknowledging underwriters are chased and logged until acknowledgement is captured.
generic.Test population: All underwriters and managers on the affected-line distribution list.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the change note is issued on or after the effective date.
generic.Exception handling path: Underwriters raising questions are routed to the Portfolio UW Manager before the effective date.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Dated change note issued before the effective date with before and after values and referral triggers.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting intranet appetite page and the acknowledgement log held with the change record.

steps.title: Draft the appetite change note with before and after values
sop: Draft the note stating what changed with the before and after value for each parameter.
State the effective date and the lines of business affected.
Keep the note to what an underwriter must do differently.
Done when the draft shows before and after values for every changed parameter.
verify: Check each changed parameter shows both values.
Pass when no parameter shows only the new value.

steps.title: State the transition treatment for in-flight submissions
sop: State how quotes already issued and submissions in progress are treated.
Give the cut-off point at which the new rules apply.
Name who decides borderline transition cases.
Done when the transition treatment and cut-off are stated.
verify: Check the note for a stated transition treatment and cut-off.
Pass when both appear in the note.

steps.title: Explain the new referral triggers and routing
sop: Explain each new referral trigger configured in the underwriting workstation.
Name the authority the referral routes to and the expected response time.
Give an example submission that would now refer.
Done when every new referral trigger is explained with its routing.
verify: Compare the explained triggers to the workstation configuration.
Pass when the note matches the configured triggers.

steps.title: Issue the note to the affected lines before the effective date
sop: Confirm the distribution list covers every underwriter and manager in the affected lines.
Issue the note before the effective date.
Record the issue date and the recipient list.
Done when the note is issued before the effective date to the full list.
verify: Compare the issue date to the effective date.
Pass when the issue date precedes the effective date.

steps.title: Capture acknowledgement from affected underwriters
sop: Acknowledge receipt of the change note.
Raise questions on the change to the Portfolio UW Manager before the effective date.
Confirm understanding of the new referral triggers.
Done when acknowledgement is captured for every affected underwriter.
verify: Compare acknowledgements captured to the distribution list.
Pass when every recipient on the list has acknowledged or been chased.

steps.title: Publish the current rules and retire the superseded page
sop: Publish the current appetite rules to the underwriting intranet page.
Retire the superseded page so only current rules are discoverable.
Confirm links from bulletins and training material point to the current page.
Done when the current page is live and the superseded page is retired.
verify: Search the intranet for the superseded appetite page.
Pass when only the current page is reachable.

generic.Defined scope/population: All proposed appetite changes tabled at the quarterly review with product management, actuarial and reinsurance represented.
generic.In-scope period: The review quarter, with the pre-read circulated at least five working days before the meeting.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Attendance, proposed change, decision, reason, action owner and due date recorded for the meeting.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Decisions recorded match the number of proposed changes tabled.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Minutes and agreed change list retained with the meeting date and pre-read version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Changes amended or rejected carry the reason and any follow-up work required.
generic.Test population: All proposed appetite changes on the quarterly review agenda.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the pre-read was circulated fewer than five working days before the meeting.
generic.Exception handling path: Changes deferred for missing evidence return to the next quarterly review with the evidence supplied.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Minutes recording attendance from product management, actuarial and reinsurance and a decision per change.
generic.Evidence location: Appetite review folder holding the pre-read, minutes and agreed change list.

steps.title: Assemble the pre-read in Microsoft Excel and Power BI
sop: Assemble portfolio performance, appetite utilisation, concentration position and proposed changes into the pre-read.
Include the actuarial view from the modelling platform for changes with a pricing dependency.
Version the pre-read and record its date.
Done when the pre-read covers all four sections and is versioned.
verify: Check the pre-read contents against the standard agenda sections.
Pass when no standard section is missing.

steps.title: Circulate the pre-read five working days ahead
sop: Circulate the pre-read at least five working days before the meeting.
Send to underwriting, product management, actuarial and reinsurance attendees.
Record the circulation date and recipients.
Done when the pre-read is circulated within the lead time.
verify: Compare circulation date to the meeting date.
Pass when at least five working days separate the two.

steps.title: Confirm cross-functional representation before proceeding
sop: Confirm product management, actuarial and reinsurance are represented at the meeting.
Record attendance by function at the start of the meeting.
Defer items dependent on an absent function.
Done when attendance is confirmed and recorded by function.
verify: Check the recorded attendance covers all three functions.
Pass when all three functions are recorded as present.

steps.title: Work through each proposed appetite change
sop: Take each proposed change in turn with its supporting evidence.
Record agree, amend or reject with the reason for each.
State any condition attached to an agreed change.
Done when every proposed change has a recorded decision.
verify: Compare decisions recorded to changes tabled.
Pass when the two counts are equal.

steps.title: Capture actions with owners and due dates
sop: Capture the guideline, system and communication work arising from agreed changes.
Assign an owner and due date to each action.
Confirm the owners accept the dates in the meeting.
Done when every action has an owner and a due date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every approved appetite parameter to be configured as an eligibility, referral or hard-stop rule in the underwriting system.
generic.In-scope period: From the approved effective date until the rule is superseded by a later approved change.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Eligible classes, geography, limit and attachment bands, prohibited risks, referral level and effective date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Configured rule count matches the approved parameter list from the appetite decision record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Change record, test evidence, tester, approver and activation timestamp captured in the system audit trail.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Test scripts that fail are logged with the fix applied and re-tested before go-live.
generic.Test population: The scripted set of in-appetite, referral and prohibited sample submissions.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any superseded appetite rule is still active after the effective date.
generic.Exception handling path: Out-of-appetite submissions route to the correct authority level rather than binding.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Rules active on the approved effective date with change record, test evidence and audit trail entries.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting workstation configuration audit trail and the test evidence pack.

steps.title: Configure eligibility and prohibited-risk rules

Set the activation date to the approved effective date.

verify: Compare each referral routing to the authority matrix.
Pass when no referral routes below the required level.

steps.title: Run the scripted test set before go-live
sop: Run the scripted in-appetite, referral and prohibited sample submissions.
Record the actual outcome against the expected outcome for each script.
Report failures for correction and re-test.

verify: Compare actual to expected outcome for every script.

Deactivate the superseded rules at the same time.
